1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

1. haituṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau, adausaṃ paṭic‍ca alaubhau amauhau, amauhaṃ paṭic‍ca alaubhau adausau, laubhaṃ paṭic‍ca  mauhau, mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca laubhau, dausaṃ paṭic‍ca mauhau, mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca dausau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhaṃ paṭic‍ca mauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

2. nahaituṃ  dhammaṃ  paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā; aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nahaitū khandhai paṭic‍ca haitū; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca haitū| (2)

nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā haitu ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā haitu ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca haitū sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

3. haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – alaubhañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca mauhau, dausañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca mauhau…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… alaubhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau…pai॰…| (1)

haituñ‍ca  nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca haituñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai ca haituñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuñ‍ca haituñ‍ca paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti  haitupac‍cayā – nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca alaubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā adausau amauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai ca alaubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā adausau amauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ (cak‍kaṃ)| nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca laubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuñ‍ca alaubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayādi

4. haituṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā (rūpaṃ chaḍḍaitvā arūpaiyaiva nava pañhā)… adhipatipac‍cayā (paṭisandhi natthi, paripuṇṇaṃ) aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ… (imaṃ nānaṃ) anantarapac‍cayā… samanantarapac‍cayā… sahajātapac‍cayā (sabbai mahābhūtā yāva asañ‍ñasattā)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā… nissayapac‍cayā… upanissayapac‍cayā… puraijātapac‍cayā… āsaivanapac‍cayā (dvīsupi paṭisandhi natthi)… kammapac‍cayā… vipākapac‍cayā (saṃkhittaṃ)… avigatapac‍cayā|

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

5. haituyā nava, ārammaṇai nava (sabbattha nava), avigatai nava (aivaṃ gaṇaitabbaṃ)|

anulaumaṃ|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

nahaitupac‍cayau

6. nahaituṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca  rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā; aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰…|(1)

nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

naārammaṇapac‍cayādi

7. haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – haituṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

nahaituṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – nahaitū khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… sabbai mahābhūtā…pai॰…| (1)

haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… naadhipatipac‍cayā… (paripuṇṇaṃ) naanantarapac‍cayā… nasamanantarapac‍cayā… naañ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā… naupanissayapac‍cayā|

napuraijātapac‍cayau

8. haituṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhaṃ paṭic‍ca mauhau, mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca laubhau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai haituṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā, haituṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhaṃ paṭic‍ca mauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

9. nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… nahaitū khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai nahaitū khandhai paṭic‍ca haitū; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā haitu ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

10. haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai alaubhañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau  (cak‍kaṃ)| arūpai laubhañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca mauhau (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

haituñ‍ca  nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca haituñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… nahaitū khandhai ca haituñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, haituñ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca alaubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā adausau amauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ)| nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca laubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau ca (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

napacchājātapac‍cayādi

11. haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati napacchājātapac‍cayā… naāsaivanapac‍cayā|

nakammapac‍cayādi

12. haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati nakammapac‍cayā – haituṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā caitanā| (1)

nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati nakammapac‍cayā – nahaitū khandhai paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā caitanā… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

haituñ‍ca nahaituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati nakammapac‍cayā – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā caitanā| (1)

haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati navipākapac‍cayā… nava|

naāhārapac‍cayādi

13. nahaituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nahaitu dhammau uppaj‍jati naāhārapac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰… naindriyapac‍cayā  – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ … utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pai॰… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ, najhānapac‍cayā – pañ‍caviñ‍ñāṇaṃ  …pai॰… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰… namaggapac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ nahaituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca…pai॰… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰… nasampayuttapac‍cayā… navippayuttapac‍cayā… (napuraijātasadisaṃ, arūpapañhāyaiva) naunatthipac‍cayā… nauvigatapac‍cayā|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

14. nahaituyā dvai, naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai tīṇi, nasamanantarai tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai tīṇi, naupanissayai tīṇi, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai nava, naāhārai aikaṃ, naindriyai aikaṃ, najhānai aikaṃ, namaggai aikaṃ, nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai nava, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi (aivaṃ gaṇaitabbaṃ)|

pac‍canīyaṃ|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

haitudukaṃ

15. haitupac‍cayā naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai tīṇi…pai॰… naupanissayai tīṇi, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai nava, nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai  nava, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

anulaumapac‍canīyaṃ|

4. pac‍cayapac‍canīyānulaumaṃ

nahaitudukaṃ

16. nahaitupac‍cayā  ārammaṇai dvai, anantarai dvai…pai॰… kammai dvai, vipākai aikaṃ, āhārai dvai, indriyai dvai, jhānai dvai, maggai aikaṃ, sampayuttai dvai…pai॰… avigatai dvai|

pac‍canīyānulaumaṃ|

2-6 sahajāta-pac‍caya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavārau

(sahajātavāraupi pac‍cayavāraupi nissayavāraupi paṭic‍cavārasadisāyaiva pañhā| mahābhūtaisu niṭṭhitaisu ‘‘vatthuṃ pac‍cayā’’ti kātabbā| pañ‍cāyatanāni anulaumaipi pac‍canīyaipi yathā labbhanti tathā kātabbā| saṃsaṭṭhavāraupi sampayuttavāraupi paripuṇṇau| rūpaṃ natthi, arūpamaiva|)

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

17. haitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – alaubhau adausassa amauhassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhau mauhassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, dausau mauhassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

haitu  dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

haitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – alaubhau adausassa amauhassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhau mauhassa…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

18. haitu  dhammau haitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituṃ ārabbha haitū uppaj‍janti| (1)

haitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituṃ ārabbha nahaitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

haitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituṃ ārabbha haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

19. nahaitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati| jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ariyā nahaitū pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ, nahaitū khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina nahaitucittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti| ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ ākāsānañ‍cāyatanakiriyaṃ (syā॰) aivamuparipi tīsu ṭhānaisu viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ  naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa  …pai॰… nahaitū khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā (paṭhamagamanaṃyaiva, āvaj‍janā natthi| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassāti idaṃ natthi)| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, taṃ  ārabbha haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti (tattha tattha ṭhitaina imaṃ kātabbaṃ dutiyagamanasadisaṃ)| (3)

20. haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā haitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha haitū uppaj‍janti| (1)

haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā nahaitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha nahaitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

21. haitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – haituṃ garuṃ katvā haitū  uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – haitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ haitūnaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – haituṃ garuṃ katvā nahaitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – haitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – haituṃ garuṃ katvā haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – haitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

22. nahaitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā (vitthāraitabbaṃ yāva| nahaitū khandhā)| sahajātādhipati – nahaitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu  dhammau haitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā (saṃkhittaṃ| yāva vatthu nahaitū ca khandhā tāva kātabbaṃ)| sahajātādhipati nahaitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ haitūnaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, taṃ garuṃ katvā nahaitū khandhā ca haitū ca uppaj‍janti, pubbai suciṇṇāni (yāva vatthu nahaitū khandhā, ca tāva kātabbaṃ)| sahajātādhipati – nahaitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

23. haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā haitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai garuṃ katvā haitū uppaj‍janti| (1)

haitu  ca nahaitu ca dhammā nahaitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai garuṃ katvā nahaitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai garuṃ katvā haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

anantarapac‍cayau

24. haitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

25. nahaitu  dhammau  nahaitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nahaitū khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa (saṃkhittaṃ) naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰…| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (nahaitumūlakaṃ tīṇipi aikasadisaṃ)| (3)

26. haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā haitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā  haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā nahaitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

upanissayapac‍cayau

28. haitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū haitūnaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu  dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

29. nahaitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰… pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti…pai॰… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰… pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰… pakatūpanissayau (dutiyaupanissayasadisaṃ)| (3)

30. haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā haitussa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā haitūnaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā nahaitussa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau  …pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau  – haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā haitūnañ‍ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

puraijātapac‍cayau

31. nahaitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰…  vatthu nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu haitūnaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vippayuttapac‍cayau

38. haitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai haitū kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| haitū vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – haitū puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu  dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – nahaitū khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai nahaitū khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| khandhā vatthussa…pai॰… vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa, vatthu nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nahaitū khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu haitūnaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu haitūnaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

haitū ca nahaitū ca dhammā nahaitussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai haitū  ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitu dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā  – haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – haitū puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – alaubhau adausassa amauhassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhau mauhassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

40. nahaitu  dhammau nahaitussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – nahaitu aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai nahaitu aikau khandhau  tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pai॰… khandhā vatthussa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰…| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ…pai॰… dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa, cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa, vatthu nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nahaitū khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātā – nahaitū khandhā sampayuttakānaṃ haitūnaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthu haitūnaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; vatthu haitūnaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu dhammau haitussa ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nahaitu aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ  atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthu haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; vatthu haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

41. haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā haitussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – alaubhau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā adausassa amauhassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā mauhassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… alaubhau ca vatthu ca adausassa amauhassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā nahaitussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – nahaitu aikau khandhau ca haitū ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai haitū ca vatthu ca nahaitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – haitū ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – haitū ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – haitū ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu ca nahaitu ca dhammā haitussa  ca nahaitussa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nahaitu aikau khandhau ca alaubhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ adausassa amauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| nahaitu aikau khandhau ca laubhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai nahaitu aikau khandhau ca alaubhau ca (cak‍kaṃ)| paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… alaubhau ca vatthu ca adausassa amauhassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, laubhau ca vatthu ca mauhassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…|

haitupac‍cayau

49. sahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

50. ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau mahābhūtā…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

ahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukā khandhā| (2)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca  sahaitukā khandhā, mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

51. sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukañ‍ca  ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

52. sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā  – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

53. ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukā khandhā| (1)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukā khandhā| (2)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau  khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

adhipatipac‍cayau

54. sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (1)

anantarapac‍cayādi

56. sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati anantarapac‍cayā… samanantarapac‍cayā… sahajātapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā – sahaitukai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti sahajātapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

57. ahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai  paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā; aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ  aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā (imai pañ‍ca pañhā haitusadisā, nin‍nānaṃ)| (2)

añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayau

58. sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukai khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu| (2)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā vatthu ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

59. ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā vatthu ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ, yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukā khandhā| (2)

sahaitukañ‍ca  ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca  sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca  tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

nissayapac‍cayādi

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati  napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā tāva vitthārau)| (1)

ahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – arūpai vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukā khandhā| (2)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti napuraijātapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukā khandhā, mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati napuraijātapac‍cayā – sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

72. sahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā (sahaitukamūlakaṃ paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)|

ahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukā khandhā| (2)

73. sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca  pac‍cayā tayau  khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

74. sahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

75. ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ pac‍cayā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukā khandhā| (1)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā mauhau ca| (3)

76. sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ  pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukañ‍ca  ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

anantarapac‍cayādi

78. sahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati anantarapac‍cayā… samanantarapac‍cayā… sahajātapac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍cavārasadisā)|

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā), cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukā khandhā| (1)

ahaitukaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

ahaitukaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti sahajātapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukā khandhā, mahābhūtai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ  mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ…pai॰…| (3)

79. sahaitukañ‍ca  ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukau dhammau uppaj‍jati sahajātapac‍cayā – sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

sahaitukañ‍ca ahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti sahajātapac‍cayā – sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca  vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

sahaitukau  dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahaitukā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

97. ahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

98. sahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhati| ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… sahaitukai  khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai sahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; caitaupariyañāṇaina sahaitukacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti| ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… sahaitukā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sahaitukai khandhai ārabbha sahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

sahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahaitukai khandhai anic‍catau  …pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, kusalākusalai niruddhai ahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati, sahaitukai khandhai ārabbha ahaitukā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (2)

sahaitukau  dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahaitukai khandhai ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

99. ahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nibbānaṃ āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ… ahaitukai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai ahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… ahaitukai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha ahaitukā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (1)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ariyā ahaitukai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ…pai॰… ahaitukai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai sahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina ahaitukacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti; ahaitukā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ahaitukai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha sahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhuṃ ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti; sautaṃ  …pai॰… vatthuṃ… ahaitukai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

100. sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha sahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

sahaitukau  ca ahaitukau ca dhammā ahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha ahaitukā khandhā  ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (2)

sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

101. sahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… sahaitukai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – sahaitukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – sahaitukādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati  – sahaitukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ… ahaitukai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati; taṃ  garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (1)

anantarapac‍cayau

102. sahaitukau  dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sahaitukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa… anulaumaṃ vaudānassa… gautrabhu maggassa… vaudānaṃ maggassa… maggau phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa… anulaumaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… niraudhā vuṭṭhahantassa naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sahaitukaṃ cuticittaṃ ahaitukassa upapatticittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sahaitukaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvaj‍janāya anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sahaitukaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ ahaitukassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sahaitukā khandhā ahaitukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

103. ahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau  vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimassa  pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā ahaitukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā pañ‍can‍naṃ viñ‍ñāṇānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ahaitukaṃ cuticittaṃ sahaitukassa upapatticittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ahaitukaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ sahaitukassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ahaitukā khandhā sahaitukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

104. sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau  ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ… mauhaṃ upanissāya  dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… mauhau ca saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

108. sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ahaitukau  dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vipākau ahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhā vatthussa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

indriyapac‍cayādi

ahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ahaitukā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

115. sahaitukau  dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – sahaitukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – sahaitukā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (1)

ahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – ahaitukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai ahaitukā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa… vatthu ahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ahaitukā khandhā ca mauhau ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā ahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau  ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

atthipac‍cayau

116. sahaitukau  dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – sahaitukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā mauhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – sahaitukā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahaitukau  dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukau…pai॰…| (3)

117. ahaitukau dhammau ahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – ahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā kātabbaṃ)| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ  anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, kusalākusalai niruddhai ahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu ahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ahaitukā khandhā ca mauhau ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau  imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai sahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, vatthu sahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ahaitukau dhammau sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ  cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā  ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti, vatthu vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

118. sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau aikau khandhau ca mauhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – sahaitukau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (1)

sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā ahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – sahaitukā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai sahaitukā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| sahajātā – vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca mauhassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – sahaitukā khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – sahaitukā  khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahaitukau ca ahaitukau ca dhammā sahaitukassa ca ahaitukassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau aikau khandhau ca mauhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰…| sahajātau – vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (3)

haitupac‍cayau

127. haituñ‍caiva  sahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhaṃ paṭic‍ca mauhau (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

haituñ‍caiva sahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – haituṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

haituñ‍caiva sahaitukañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu caiva sahaitukau  ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – alaubhaṃ paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhaṃ paṭic‍ca mauhau sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

128. sahaitukañ‍caiva  na ca haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati  haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…|(1)

sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukai caiva na ca haitū khandhai paṭic‍ca haitū; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā haitu ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

129. haituñ‍caiva sahaitukañ‍ca sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – alaubhañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca adausau amauhau (cak‍kaṃ)| laubhañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca mauhau (cak‍kaṃ); paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

haituñ‍caiva sahaitukañ‍ca sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituñ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca haituñ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

haituñ‍caiva sahaitukañ‍ca sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituñ‍ca dhammaṃ  paṭic‍ca haitu caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sahaitukañ‍caiva na ca haituṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca alaubhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā adausau amauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

haitupac‍cayau

136. haitu  caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – alaubhau adausassa amauhassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (yathā paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)| (1)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

137. haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituṃ ārabbha haitū uppaj‍janti| (1)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituṃ ārabbha sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa  ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituṃ ārabbha haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati| jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti| sahaitukai caiva na ca haitū khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| caitaupariyañāṇaina sahaitukā caiva na ca haitucittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti; ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā… (yathā paṭhamagamanaṃ aivaṃ nin‍nānaṃ)| (2)

sahaitukau  caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā… (yathā paṭhamagamanaṃ aivaṃ nin‍nānaṃ)| (3)

138. haitu caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha haitū uppaj‍janti| (1)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

haitu  caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – haituñ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

139. haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – haituṃ garuṃ katvā haitū uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – haitu caiva sahaitukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ haitūnaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – haituṃ garuṃ katvā sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – haitu caiva sahaitukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – haituṃ garuṃ katvā  haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – haitu caiva sahaitukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnañ‍ca adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

140. sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, sahaitukai caiva na ca haitū khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi  uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā… (paṭhamagamanaṃyaiva)| sahajātādhipati – sahaitukau caiva na  ca haitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ haitūnaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā… (paṭhamagamanaṃyaiva)| sahajātādhipati – sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnañ‍ca adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

141. haitu caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – haitū ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai garuṃ katvā haitū uppaj‍janti| (1)

anantarapac‍cayau

142. haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā  haitū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sahaitukānañ‍caiva na ca haitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā haitū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

143. sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sahaitukānañ‍caiva na ca haitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa… anulaumaṃ vaudānassa…pai॰… niraudhā vuṭṭhahantassa, naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa… (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

sahaitukau  caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰…| (3)

(sahaitukau caiva na ca haitumūlakaṃ tīṇipi aikasadisā|)

144. haitu  caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – purimā purimā haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ haitūnaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

146. haitu caiva sahaitukau ca dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū haitūnaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) haitū sahaitukānañ‍caiva  na ca haitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) haitū haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (imaisaṃ dvin‍nampi pañhānaṃ mūlāni pucchitabbāni)|

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa  upanissayapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… patthanā saddhāya…pai॰… patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

(sahaitukau caiva na ca haitumūlakai iminākāraina vitthāraitabbā avasaisā dvai pañhā|)

haitu caiva sahaitukau ca sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu ca dhammā haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā haitūnaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (dvai mūlāni pucchitabbāni) haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā sahaitukānañ‍caiva na ca haitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) haitū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā haitūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

kammapac‍cayau

148. sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā  – sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū caitanā vipākānaṃ  sahaitukānañ‍caiva na ca haitūnaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ haitūnaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū caitanā vipākānaṃ haitūnaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahaitukau caiva na ca haitu dhammau haitussa caiva sahaitukassa ca sahaitukassa caiva na ca haitussa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnañ‍ca kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – sahaitukā caiva na ca haitū caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitūnañ‍ca kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)
