1. vibhaṅgavārau

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

176. nahaitu  sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati; jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… nahaitū sahaitukai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai nahaitu sahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; caitaupariyañāṇaina nahaitusahaitukacittasamaṅgissa  cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ…pai॰… nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nahaitū sahaitukai khandhai ārabbha nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nahaitū sahaitukai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ  uppaj‍jati, kusalākusalai niruddhai nahaitu ahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati, nahaitū sahaitukai khandhai ārabbha nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

177. nahaitu  ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nibbānaṃ āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ… nahaitū ahaitukai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai nahaitu ahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… nahaitū ahaitukai khandhai ārabbha nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ… nahaitū ahaitukai khandhai anic‍catau  …pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai nahaitu sahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina nahaituahaitukacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti| nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nahaitū ahaitukai khandhai ārabbha nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

adhipatipac‍cayau

178. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti| nahaitū sahaitukai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nahaitusahaitukādhipati  sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – nahaitu sahaitukādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu  sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa ca nahaituahaitukassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – nahaitu sahaitukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ  khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ… nahaitū ahaitukai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (1)

anantarapac‍cayau

179. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nahaitu sahaitukaṃ cuticittaṃ nahaituahaitukassa upapatticittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nahaitu sahaitukaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvaj‍janāya, nahaitu sahaitukaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ nahaituahaitukassa bhavaṅgassa, nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā nahaituahaitukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ  nahaituahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā pañ‍can‍naṃ viñ‍ñāṇānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nahaitu ahaitukaṃ cuticittaṃ nahaitusahaitukassa upapatticittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā nahaitusahaitukānaṃ  khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā nahaitusahaitukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

180. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (iha ghaṭanā natthi, satta pañhā)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cha pañhā)… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (pavattipaṭisandhi satta pañhā, iha ghaṭanā natthi)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

181. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… patthanā saddhāya…pai॰… patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhā kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sīlaṃ…pai॰… patthanā kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa  dukkhassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; saddhā…pai॰… patthanā kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

182. nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa  upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu  ahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ …pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

puraijātapac‍cayau

183. nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; kusalākusalai niruddhai nahaitu ahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa… vatthu nahaituahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, kusalākusalai niruddhai nahaitu sahaitukau vipākau tadārammaṇatā uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

pacchājātapac‍cayau

184. nahaitu  sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu  ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsaivanapac‍cayau

185. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa… anulaumaṃ vaudānassa… gautrabhu maggassa… vaudānaṃ maggassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā  purimā nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahaituahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

kammapac‍cayau

186. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – nahaitu sahaitukā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – nahaitu sahaitukā caitanā vipākānaṃ nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – nahaitu sahaitukā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – nahaitu sahaitukā caitanā vipākānaṃ nahaituahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu  sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa ca nahaituahaitukassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – nahaitu sahaitukā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā  – nahaitu sahaitukā caitanā vipākānaṃ nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – nahaitu ahaitukā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai nahaitu ahaitukā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ  khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āhārapac‍cayau

sampayuttapac‍cayau

191. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa sampayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – nahaitu sahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

vippayuttapac‍cayau

192. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – nahaitū sahaitukā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – nahaitū ahaitukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nahaitū ahaitukā  khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nahaitu ahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ  – vatthu nahaitusahaitukānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

atthipac‍cayau

193. nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nahaitu sahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaituahaitukassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ…pai॰…| (2)

nahaitu sahaitukau dhammau nahaitusahaitukassa ca nahaituahaitukassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nahaitu sahaitukau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

anidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sanidassanau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – anidassanai khandhai paṭic‍ca sanidassanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca sanidassanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)

anidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sanidassanau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai anidassanai khandhai paṭic‍ca sanidassanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… mahābhūtai  paṭic‍ca  sanidassanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ… bāhirai… āhārasamuṭṭhānai… utusamuṭṭhānai… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca sanidassanaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (2)

35. sanidassanau  dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sanidassanā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (1)

anidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ  pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kāyaṃ… saddai…pai॰… vatthuṃ anidassanai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina anidassanacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… saddāyatanaṃ sautaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… anidassanā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā  taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anidassanai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – anidassanādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anidassanau dhammau sanidassanassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – anidassanādhipati sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

anidassanau dhammau sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – anidassanādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ  sanidassanānañ‍ca anidassanānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

40. sanidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā  rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

42. anidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā anidassanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa… anulaumaṃ vaudānassa… gautrabhu maggassa… vaudānaṃ maggassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

kammapac‍cayau

43. anidassanau  dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – anidassanā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – anidassanā  caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

vippayuttapac‍cayau

45. anidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai anidassanā khandhā anidassanānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā puraijātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anidassanau dhammau sanidassanassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ  rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā puraijātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

anidassanau dhammau sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānañ‍ca anidassanānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā puraijātassa imassa sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

atthipac‍cayādi

46. sanidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anidassanau dhammau anidassanassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – anidassanau  aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ| yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, saddāyatanaṃ sautaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā puraijātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa anidassanassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ anidassanānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anidassanau dhammau sanidassanassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ  atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… mahābhūtā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ  upādārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… bāhirā… āhārasamuṭṭhānā… utusamuṭṭhānā… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ mahābhūtā sanidassanānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ, upādārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – anidassanā khandhā puraijātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sanidassanānaṃ  kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

anidassanau dhammau sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – anidassanau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ sanidassanānañ‍ca anidassanānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… mahābhūtā sanidassanānañ‍ca anidassanānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ, kaṭattārūpānaṃ, upādārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; bāhirā… āhārasamuṭṭhānā… utusamuṭṭhānā… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ mahābhūtā sanidassanānañ‍ca anidassanānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

47. sanidassanau ca anidassanau ca dhammā anidassanassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – rūpāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

haitupac‍cayau

53. sappaṭighaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā, dvai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, sappaṭighai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭic‍ca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰… rasāyatanaṃ| (1)

sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sappaṭighai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca āpaudhātu, sappaṭighai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭic‍ca āpaudhātu itthindriyaṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau| (2)

sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā āpaudhātu ca, dvai mahābhūtai…pai॰… sappaṭighai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ  paṭic‍ca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰… rasāyatanaṃ āpaudhātu itthindriyaṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau| (3)

54. appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – appaṭighaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca itthindriyaṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau| (1)

appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – appaṭighai khandhai paṭic‍ca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighā mahābhūtā, āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ| (2)

appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – appaṭighaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau| (3)

55. sappaṭighañ‍ca  appaṭighañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – appaṭighai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā…pai॰… sappaṭighai mahābhūtai ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – appaṭighai khandhai ca mahābhūtai  ca paṭic‍ca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai appaṭighai  khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca appaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca itthindriyaṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau| (2)

sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – appaṭighai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… appaṭighai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pai॰… rasāyatanaṃ, itthindriyaṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

56. appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – appaṭighaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā|

adhipatipac‍cayādi

57. sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā (paṭisandhi vaj‍jaitabbā, kaṭattārūpā ca)… anantarapac‍cayā… samanantarapac‍cayā… sahajātapac‍cayā (sabbai mahābhūtā kātabbā)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā, dvai mahābhūtai…pai॰…| (1)

sappaṭighaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca  appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – sappaṭighai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca āpaudhātu…pai॰…| (2)

sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā  – sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā āpaudhātu ca, dvai mahābhūtai…pai॰…| (3)

58. appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca appaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – appaṭighaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā| (1)

appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – āpaudhātuṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighā mahābhūtā (imai ajjhattikabāhirā mahābhūtā kātabbā)| (2)

sappaṭighañ‍ca appaṭighañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sappaṭighau dhammau uppaj‍jati añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayā – sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtañ‍ca āpaudhātuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā…pai॰… nissayapac‍cayā…pai॰… avigatapac‍cayā|

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

(appaṭighamūlakaṃ itaraipi dvai pañhā kātabbā| ghaṭanaipi tīṇi pañhā kātabbā| ajjhattikā bāhirā mahābhūtā sabbai jānitvā kātabbā|)

appaṭighau  dhammau sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – appaṭighā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ‍ca appaṭighānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – appaṭighā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ‍ca appaṭighānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākapac‍cayau

79. appaṭighau  dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vipākau appaṭighau…pai॰… tīṇi|

āhārapac‍cayau

80. appaṭighau dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – appaṭighā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (avasaisā dvaipi pañhā kātabbā, paṭisandhi kabaḷīkārau āhārau dvīsupi kātabbau aggai)| (3)

indriyapac‍cayādi

81. sappaṭighau dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

appaṭighau dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (tīsupi jīvitindriyaṃ aggai kātabbaṃ)| (3)

sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

82. sappaṭighau  dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

appaṭighau dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā puraijātassa imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

appaṭighau dhammau sappaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā puraijātassa imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

appaṭighau dhammau sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā sappaṭighānañ‍ca appaṭighānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai  …pai॰…| pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā puraijātassa imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

atthipac‍cayau

83. sappaṭighau dhammau sappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ (paṭic‍casadisā paṭhamapañhā)| (1)

sappaṭighau  dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātā – sappaṭighā mahābhūtā āpaudhātuyā atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, sappaṭighā mahābhūtā appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ itthindriyassa…pai॰… kabaḷīkārassa āhārassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰…| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sappaṭighau dhammau sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sappaṭighaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dvin‍naṃ mahābhūtānaṃ āpaudhātuyā ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (3)

84. appaṭighau dhammau appaṭighassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – appaṭighau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| puraijātaṃ – vatthuṃ…pai॰… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpaudhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; vatthu appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā puraijātassa imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ appaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

appaṭighau dhammau sappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… āpaudhātu sappaṭighānaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āpaudhātu sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āpaudhātu cakkhāyatanassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanassa atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; bāhiraṃ, āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ, utusamuṭṭhānaṃ, asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰…| pacchājātā – appaṭighā  khandhā puraijātassa imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

appaṭighau dhammau sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – appaṭighau  aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ‍ca appaṭighānañ‍ca…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| pacchājātā – appaṭighā khandhā puraijātassa imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sappaṭighānañ‍ca appaṭighānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

85. sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā sappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisaṃ yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā appaṭighassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātā – appaṭighā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai  khandhā ca…pai॰…| (2)

sappaṭighau ca appaṭighau ca dhammā sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (3)

93. rūpiṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca rūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau mahābhūtā…pai॰… dvai mahābhūtai…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca arūpinau khandhā| (2)

100. nahaitupac‍cayā ārammaṇai tīṇi, anantarai tīṇi, samanantarai tīṇi, sahajātai nava, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nissayai nava, upanissayai tīṇi, puraijātai aikaṃ, āsaivanai aikaṃ, kammai nava, vipākai nava, āhārai nava, indriyai nava, jhānai nava, maggai aikaṃ, sampayuttai tīṇi, vippayuttai nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigatai tīṇi, avigatai nava|

pac‍canīyānulaumaṃ|

haitupac‍cayau

101. rūpiṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (1)

rūpiṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā arūpinau khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

rūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā arūpinau khandhā, mahābhūtai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (aivaṃ avasaisā pañhā, pavattipaṭisandhi vibhajitabbā)| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

102. rūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā arūpinau khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

arūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – arūpiṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (2)

rūpiñ‍ca arūpiñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai  …pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ…pai॰… arūpiṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

103. haituyā nava, ārammaṇai tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantarai tīṇi, samanantarai tīṇi, sahajātai nava, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nissayai  nava, upanissayai tīṇi, puraijātai tīṇi, āsaivanai tīṇi, kammai nava…pai॰… maggai nava, sampayuttai tīṇi, vippayuttai nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigatai tīṇi, avigatai nava|

anulaumaṃ|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

nahaitupac‍cayau

104. rūpiṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

rūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukā arūpinau  khandhā; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

rūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā (pavattipaṭisandhi kātabbā)| (3)

105. arūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ arūpiṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

arūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai arūpinau khandhai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

arūpiṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ arūpiṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

106. rūpiñ‍ca arūpiñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai arūpinau khandhai  ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

rūpiñ‍ca arūpiñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā arūpī dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ…pai॰… arūpiṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

rūpiñ‍ca  arūpiñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā  – ahaitukaṃ arūpiṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… arūpinau khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

107. nahaituyā nava, naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai tīṇi, nasamanantarai tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai tīṇi, naupanissayai tīṇi, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai cattāri, navipākai nava, naāhārai aikaṃ, naindriyai aikaṃ, najhānai cattāri, namaggai nava, nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai dvai, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

pac‍canīyaṃ|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

haitudukaṃ

1-4. pac‍cayānulaumādi

haituyā aikaṃ…pai॰… avigatai aikaṃ| (aivaṃ pac‍canīyādīni gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāraipi sabbai kātabbā| aikauyaiva pañhau)|

11. rūpīdukaṃ

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

111. arūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – arūpī haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – arūpī haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – arūpī haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ  haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

112. rūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpaudhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpinau khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

113. arūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… arūpinau khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, caitaupariyañāṇaina arūpicittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ…pai॰… naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… arūpinau khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

adhipatipac‍cayau

114. rūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (1)

arūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ) nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; arūpinau khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti…pai॰… rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – arūpī adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – arūpī adhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

arūpī  dhammau rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – arūpī adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

anantarapac‍cayādi

115. arūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā arūpinau khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

(sahajātapac‍cayai satta, iha ghaṭanā natthi| añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayai cha, nissayapac‍cayai satta pañhā, iha ghaṭanā natthi)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

116. rūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati, utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

arūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pai॰… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

puraijātapac‍cayau

117. rūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ anic‍catau  …pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

pacchājātapac‍cayau

118. arūpī  dhammau rūpissa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā arūpinau khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsaivanapac‍cayau

119. arūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā arūpinau khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

kammapac‍cayau

120. arūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – arūpī caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – arūpī caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – arūpī caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – arūpī caitanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – arūpī caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – arūpī caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākāhārapac‍cayā

121. arūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

rūpī dhammau rūpissa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

arūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

122. rūpī  dhammau rūpissa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ  kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

rūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyaṃ…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

jhānapac‍cayādi

123. arūpī  dhammau arūpissa dhammassa jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

124. rūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – arūpinau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai arūpinau khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; arūpinau khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – arūpinau khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

atthipac‍cayādi

125. rūpī  dhammau rūpissa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātaṃ – aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā), kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

rūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa  …pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

126. arūpī dhammau arūpissa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – arūpī aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – arūpinau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… pacchājātā – arūpinau khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

arūpī dhammau rūpissa ca arūpissa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – arūpī aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

127. rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā rūpissa dhammassa  atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – arūpī khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – arūpinau khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – arūpinau khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

rūpī  ca arūpī ca dhammā arūpissa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau…pai॰… arūpī aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai arūpī aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (2)

laukuttarau dhammau laukiyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā caitaupariyañāṇaina laukuttaracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti, laukuttarā khandhā caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

13. nauāsavaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā nauāsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ nauāsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā) cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukā nauāsavā khandhā| (1)

nauāsavaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā āsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

14. nahaituyā  dvai, naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava…pai॰… nakammai tīṇi…pai॰… navippayuttai nava, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi (aivaṃ sabbai gaṇanā gaṇaitabbā)|

4. nissayavārau

(nissayavārau pac‍cayavārasadisau|)

5. saṃsaṭṭhavārau

1-4. pac‍cayānulaumādi

15. āsavaṃ  dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau āsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmāsavaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau diṭṭhāsavau avij‍jāsavau (cak‍kaṃ| saṃkhittaṃ)|

haituyā nava, ārammaṇai nava (sabbattha nava), vipākai aikaṃ…pai॰… avigatai nava|

nahaituyā dvai, naadhipatiyā nava, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai nava, najhānai aikaṃ, namaggai aikaṃ, navippayuttai nava|

6. sampayuttavārau

(gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāraupi saṃsaṭṭhavārasadisau|)

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

16. āsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kāmāsavau diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; bhavāsavau avij‍jāsavassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

āsavau  dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavau  dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kāmāsavau diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

17. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ āsavānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsavānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā nauāsavassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavā ca nauāsavā ca haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

18. āsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavai ārabbha āsavā uppaj‍janti| (1)

āsavau  dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavai ārabbha nauāsavā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

āsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavai ārabbha āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

19. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ  gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā nauāsavai pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai  kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauāsavai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina nauāsavacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… nauāsavā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā…pai॰… taṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha āsavā uppaj‍janti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauāsavai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha āsavā uppaj‍janti| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā…pai॰… (dutiyagamanaṃ) nauāsavai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

20. āsavau  ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavai ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha āsavā uppaj‍janti| (1)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā nauāsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavai ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha nauāsavā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (2)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavai ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

21. āsavau  dhammau āsavassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – āsavai garuṃ katvā āsavā uppaj‍janti (tīṇi ārammaṇasadisā, garukārammaṇā kātabbā)|

nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ garuṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauāsavai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nauāsavā adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… nauāsavai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā āsavā  uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – nauāsavā adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ āsavānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau  dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… nauāsavai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nauāsavā adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsavānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – āsavai ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti…pai॰… āsavā uppaj‍janti (tīṇi, garukārammaṇā)|

anantarapac‍cayau

22. āsavau  dhammau āsavassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā āsavā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā āsavā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nauāsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āsavā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā āsavā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

23. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nauāsavā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nauāsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nauāsavā  khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā āsavānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nauāsavā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

24. āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

samanantarapac‍cayādi

25. āsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (vatthu ca dassaitabbaṃ)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

26. āsavau  dhammau āsavassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – āsavā āsavānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (tīṇi)|

27. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya  dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya…pai॰… pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau… tīṇi|

puraijātapac‍cayau

28. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ …pai॰… vatthuṃ (aivaṃ vitthāraitabbaṃ), phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa, vatthu nauāsavānaṃ  khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha āsavā uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu āsavānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu āsavānañ‍ca āsavasampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

pacchājātapac‍cayau

29. āsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā āsavā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā nauāsavā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā nauāsavassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsaivanapac‍cayau

30. āsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

kammapac‍cayau

31. nauāsavau  dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – nauāsavā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – nauāsavā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ āsavānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau  dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsavānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākāhārapac‍cayā

32. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ, āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ āsavānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ  āsavānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

indriyapac‍cayādi

33. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauāsavā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ  indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

34. āsavau  dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – āsavā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – āsavā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

35. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – nauāsavā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu nauāsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nauāsavā khandhā puraijātassa  imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu āsavānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu āsavānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

36. āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā nauāsavassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – āsavā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

atthipac‍cayau

37. āsavau  dhammau āsavassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kāmāsavau diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

āsavau  dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – āsavā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – āsavā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavau dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kāmāsavau diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (3)

38. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – nauāsavau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu nauāsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nauāsavā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauāsavau dhammau āsavassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātā – nauāsavā khandhā āsavānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha āsavā uppaj‍janti, vatthu āsavānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauāsavau  dhammau āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nauāsavau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ āsavānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ)| (3)

39. āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – kāmāsavau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| kāmāsavau ca vatthu ca diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā nauāsavassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – nauāsavau aikau khandhau ca āsavā ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – āsavā mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āsavā ca vatthu ca nauāsavānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – āsavā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – āsavā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavau ca nauāsavau ca dhammā āsavassa ca nauāsavassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nauāsavau aikau khandhau ca kāmāsavau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ)| sahajātau – kāmāsavau ca vatthu ca diṭṭhāsavassa avij‍jāsavassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (3)

42. nauāsavau dhammau nauāsavassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

15. sāsavadukaṃ

1. paṭic‍cavārau

haitupac‍cayau

47. sāsavaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sāsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca anāsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – anāsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – anāsavai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)

anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau ca anāsavau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – anāsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

sāsavañ‍ca anāsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – anāsavai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (1)

(yathā  cūḷantaradukai laukiyadukaṃ aivaṃ kātabbaṃ nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ|)

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

48. āsavasampayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

āsavasampayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – āsavasampayuttai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, daumanassasahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca mauhau cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ| (2)

āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… daumanassasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

49. āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – āsavavippayuttaṃ  aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau mahābhūtā, tayau  mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dvai mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca dvai mahābhūtā, mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ| (3)

50. āsavasampayuttañ‍ca āsavavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

āsavasampayuttañ‍ca āsavavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – āsavasampayuttai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, daumanassasahagatai vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)

āsavasampayuttañ‍ca  āsavavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

51. āsavasampayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – āsavasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – daumanassasahagatai vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca mauhau| (2)

āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

52. āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – āsavavippayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā| (1) āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

āsavasampayuttañ‍ca āsavavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

adhipatipac‍cayau

53. āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā… tīṇi|

āsavavippayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau  dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – āsavavippayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… daumanassasahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti adhipatipac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ mauhaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ| (3)

54. āsavasampayuttañ‍ca āsavavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – daumanassasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

āsavasampayuttañ‍ca āsavavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā – āsavasampayuttai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, daumanassasahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)
