haitupac‍cayau

74. āsavasampayuttau  dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau  dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavasampayuttā haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dausau mauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dausau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

75. āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavavippayuttā  haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – daumanassasahagatau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavavippayuttau  dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – daumanassasahagatau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

76. āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dausau ca mauhau ca āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dausau ca mauhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dausau ca mauhau  ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

77. āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – āsavasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha āsavasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha āsavavippayuttā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (2)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āsavasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

78. āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ  datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggaṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā āsavavippayuttai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti; vikkhambhitai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ āsavavippayuttai khandhai anic‍catau dukkhatau anattatau vipassati| (idha assādanā natthi) dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina āsavavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… āsavavippayuttā  khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya mauhassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavavippayuttau  dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ āsavavippayuttai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau…pai॰… diṭṭhi… daumanassaṃ… vicikicchā… uddhac‍caṃ uppaj‍jati| (2)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ āsavavippayuttai khandhai ārabbha daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

79. āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – daumanassasahagatai vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha āsavasampayuttā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – daumanassasahagatai vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha āsavavippayuttā khandhā ca mauhau  ca uppaj‍janti| (2)

āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – daumanassasahagatai vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

80. āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – āsavasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – āsavasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau  dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – āsavasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatādhipati mauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – āsavasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

81. āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ  gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – āsavavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ āsavavippayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

anantarapac‍cayau

82. āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā āsavasampayuttakā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā  khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa daumanassasahagatassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; āsavasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

83. āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau daumanassasahagatau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimassa pacchimassa  daumanassasahagatassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā āsavavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau daumanassasahagatau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau daumanassasahagatau  vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

84. āsavasampayuttau  ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimassa pacchimassa daumanassasahagatassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavasampayuttau  ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ  khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

85. āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… cha… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

upanissayapac‍cayau

86. āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – āsavasampayuttā khandhā āsavasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau  – āsavasampayuttā khandhā āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavasampayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – āsavasampayuttakā khandhā daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

87. āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya  dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ… mauhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ  uppādaiti; saddhā…pai॰… pañ‍ñā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… mauhau ca saddhāya…pai॰… mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ… mauhaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… mauhau ca rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhā… sīlaṃ…pai॰… mauhau daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

88. āsavasampayuttau ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau  …pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (pucchitabbaṃ mūlaṃ) daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavasampayuttau  ca āsavavippayuttau ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – daumanassasahagatā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhac‍casahagatā  khandhā ca mauhau ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

puraijātapac‍cayau

89. āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau dukkhatau anattatau vipassati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsavavippayuttau dhammau āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

haitupac‍cayau

109. āsavañ‍caiva  sāsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavau caiva sāsavau ca dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭic‍ca diṭṭhāsavau avij‍jāsavau (cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) bhavāsavaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsavau (cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) diṭṭhāsavaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsavau| (1)

āsavañ‍caiva sāsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau caiva nau ca āsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā  – āsavai paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ| (2)

āsavañ‍caiva sāsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavau caiva sāsavau ca sāsavau caiva nau ca āsavau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – kāmāsavaṃ paṭic‍ca diṭṭhāsavau avij‍jāsavau sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, bhavāsavaṃ (cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ)| (3)

110. sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau caiva nau ca āsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

sāsavañ‍caiva  nau ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavau caiva sāsavau ca dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sāsavai caiva nau ca āsavai khandhai paṭic‍ca āsavā| (2)

sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavau caiva sāsavau ca sāsavau caiva nau ca āsavau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā āsavā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

111. āsavañ‍caiva sāsavañ‍ca sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavau caiva sāsavau ca dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmāsavañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca diṭṭhāsavau avij‍jāsavau (aivaṃ cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ)| (1)

āsavañ‍caiva sāsavañ‍ca sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sāsavau caiva nau ca āsavau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca  āsavai ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (2)

āsavañ‍caiva sāsavañ‍ca sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavau caiva sāsavau ca sāsavau caiva nau ca āsavau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sāsavañ‍caiva nau ca āsavaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca kāmāsavañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā diṭṭhāsavau avij‍jāsavau cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ| saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

1. sañ‍ñaujanaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca sīlabbataparāmāsasañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca mānasañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, paṭighasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca issāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, paṭighasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca macchariyasañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, paṭighasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, mānasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca bhavarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, bhavarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, vicikicchāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sañ‍ñaujanai paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca  rūpaṃ| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ (cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ)| (3)

2. nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanai khandhai paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanā| (2)

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā sañ‍ñaujanā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

3. sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ (cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ)| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanai ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau  ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ bandhitabbaṃ)| (3)

(ārammaṇapac‍cayai  rūpaṃ natthi| adhipatipac‍cayau haitusadisau, vicikicchāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ natthi|) anantarapac‍cayā…pai॰… avigatapac‍cayā|

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

4. haituyā nava, ārammaṇai nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantarai nava (sabbattha nava), vipākai aikaṃ, āhārai nava…pai॰… avigatai nava|

anulaumaṃ|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

nahaitupac‍cayau

5. sañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ| (1)

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vicikicchāsañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ| (3)

(saṃkhittaṃ| āsavagaucchakasadisaṃ| naārammaṇāpi sabbai uddharitabbā|)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

6. nahaituyā cattāri, naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai tīṇi, nasamanantarai tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai tīṇi, naupanissayai tīṇi, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai nava, naāhārai aikaṃ, naindriyai aikaṃ, najhānai aikaṃ, namaggai aikaṃ, nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai nava, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

pac‍canīyaṃ|

4. pac‍cayapac‍canīyānulaumaṃ

nahaitudukaṃ

8. nahaitupac‍cayā  ārammaṇai cattāri (sabbattha cattāri) vipākai aikaṃ, āhārai cattāri…pai॰… maggai tīṇi, sampayuttai cattāri…pai॰… avigatai cattāri|

pac‍canīyānulaumaṃ|

2. sahajātavārau

9. sañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ sahajātau sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā (paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)|

3. pac‍cayavārau

1-4. pac‍cayānulaumādi

haitupac‍cayau

10. sañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)|

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai pac‍cayā vatthu, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā khandhā, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, kaṭattārūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā nausañ‍ñaujanā khandhā| (1)

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanai  khandhai pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanā, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanā| (2)

nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanau ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā tayau khandhā sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanā, mahābhūtai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanā sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

11. sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca  nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai pac‍cayā diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ, kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ (cak‍kaṃ) (1)

sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanai ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ)| sañ‍ñaujanai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā nausañ‍ñaujanā khandhā| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca nausañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanau ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – nausañ‍ñaujanaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (cak‍kaṃ)| kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanaṃ avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (cak‍kaṃ| saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

12. haituyā  nava, ārammaṇai nava (sabbattha nava), vipākai aikaṃ…pai॰… avigatai nava|

13. nahaituyā  cattāri (yattha yattha vatthu labbhati, tattha tattha nin‍naitabbaṃ), naārammaṇai tīṇi…pai॰… nauvigatai tīṇi|

4. nissayavārau

(aivaṃ itaraipi dvai gaṇanā ca nissayavārau ca kātabbau|)

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

15. sañ‍ñaujanau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ sañ‍ñaujanānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanau  dhammau nausañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa ca nausañ‍ñaujanassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sañ‍ñaujanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

16. nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau nausañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nausañ‍ñaujanā haitū  sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

17. sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sañ‍ñaujanai ārabbha nausañ‍ñaujanā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sañ‍ñaujanai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

18. nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau nausañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā nausañ‍ñaujanai pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ …pai॰… vatthuṃ nausañ‍ñaujanai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina nausañ‍ñaujanacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… nausañ‍ñaujanā khandhā  iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nausañ‍ñaujanai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| (2)

nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa ca nausañ‍ñaujanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nausañ‍ñaujanai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

sañ‍ñaujanau ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (ārabbhayaiva kātabbā)|

adhipatipac‍cayau

19. sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – sañ‍ñaujanaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… tīṇi (garukārammaṇā)|

nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau nausañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… tīṇi (tiṇṇampi ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipatipi kātabbā, vibhajitabbā tīṇipi)|

sañ‍ñaujanau  ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – sañ‍ñaujanai ca sampayuttakai  ca khandhai garuṃ katvā…pai॰… tīṇi|

anantarapac‍cayau

20. sañ‍ñaujanau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sañ‍ñaujanā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sañ‍ñaujanānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau nausañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nausañ‍ñaujanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nausañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nausañ‍ñaujanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sañ‍ñaujanānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā sañ‍ñaujanānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (aivaṃ dvaipi kātabbā)| (3)

sañ‍ñaujanau ca nausañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

samanantarapac‍cayādi

21. sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

upanissayapac‍cayau

22. sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – sañ‍ñaujanā sañ‍ñaujanānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (aivaṃ tīṇipi)|

23. nausañ‍ñaujanau  dhammau nausañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya  dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ, rāgaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

haitupac‍cayau

51. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)|

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā (yāva paṭisandhi), aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau  uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā khandhā, uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūtai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ| (3)

52. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā  …pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca  rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

53. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍casadisā)|

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā (yāva paṭisandhi), vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā khandhā, uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca| (3)

54. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – uddhac‍casahagatai  khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā tayau khandhā mauhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayādi

55. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati adhipatipac‍cayā…pai॰… avigatapac‍cayā…pai॰…|

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai pac‍cayā uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ  pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau mauhau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – uddhac‍casahagataṃ mauhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttañ‍ca  sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – uddhac‍casahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca mauhañ‍ca saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1) (saṃkhittaṃ|)

(itarai dvai gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāraupi kātabbau|)

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

66. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau  sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

67. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau  cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

68. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā ca mauhau  ca uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

69. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati…pai॰… dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya mauhassa ca ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā  jhānaṃ…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

70. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca mauhañ‍ca ārabbha uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

71. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ…pai॰… diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttādhipati  cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

72. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā  maggā…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

anantarapac‍cayau

73. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā  khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā uddhac‍casahagatā  khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

74. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimassa pacchimassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – purimau purimau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

75. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimassa pacchimassa uddhac‍casahagatassa mauhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ  uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

76. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau … nava… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… cha… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

upanissayapac‍cayau

77. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

78. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ mauhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ mauhau ca saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau  dhammau  sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ  dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ mauhaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ mauhau rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhā…pai॰… pañ‍ñā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ mauhau ca uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

79. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa  ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

puraijātapac‍cayau

80. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau …pai॰… vipassati, dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ārabbha uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ  khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

pacchājātapac‍cayau

81. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā khandhā ca mauhau ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā ca mauhau ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

āsaivanapac‍cayau

82. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (āvaj‍janāpi vuṭṭhānampi natthi )|

kammapac‍cayau

83. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā caitanā sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; uddhac‍casahagatā caitanā mauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| nānākkhaṇikā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; uddhac‍casahagatā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

vipākapac‍cayau

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu uddhac‍casahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

atthipac‍cayādi

87. sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ (paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau  dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; uddhac‍casahagatā khandhā mauhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā khandhā puraijātassa  imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… uddhac‍casahagatau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ mauhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰…| (3)

88. sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ| vitthāraitabbaṃ)| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanavippayuttau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, vatthu sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanau caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanā caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā ca haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanau  caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kāmarāgasañ‍ñaujanau diṭṭhisañ‍ñaujanassa avij‍jāsañ‍ñaujanassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (3)

107. sañ‍ñaujanau caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – sañ‍ñaujanai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sañ‍ñaujanai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sañ‍ñaujanai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanai khandhai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttā caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (1)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanai khandhai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā uppaj‍janti| (2)

sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanau dhammau sañ‍ñaujanassa caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttai caiva  nau ca sañ‍ñaujanai khandhai ārabbha sañ‍ñaujanā ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

sañ‍ñaujanau caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau ca sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttau caiva nau ca sañ‍ñaujanau ca dhammā sañ‍ñaujanassa caiva sañ‍ñaujanasampayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

haitupac‍cayau

18. ganthau  dhammau ganthassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

19. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauganthā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauganthā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa  haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauganthā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

20. ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthā ca nauganthā ca haitū sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthau  ca nauganthau ca dhammā nauganthassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthā ca nauganthā ca haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthau  ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthā ca nauganthā ca haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

21. ganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthai ārabbha ganthā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ganthai ārabbha nauganthā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ganthai ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

22. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya  ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā nauganthai pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauganthai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina nauganthacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… nauganthā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauganthai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| (2)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādaiti  abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauganthai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā  ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā)|

adhipatipac‍cayau

23. ganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (ārammaṇasadisā, garukārammaṇā kātabbā)|

nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauganthai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nauganthādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai suciṇṇāni  …pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauganthai khandhai garuṃ katvā taṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nauganthādhipati ganthānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… nauganthai  khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – nauganthādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

24. ganthau  ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi|

anantarapac‍cayau

25. ganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā ganthā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā ganthā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nauganthānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ganthā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā ganthā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

26. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (dvai āvaj‍janā kātabbā, paṭhamau natthi)|

ganthau  ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (aikampi vuṭṭhānaṃ kātabbaṃ, majjhai)|

samanantarapac‍cayādi

27. ganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava, nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

upanissayapac‍cayau

28. ganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – ganthā ganthānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

29. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau …pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati  …pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca  khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau… tīṇi (ārammaṇanayaina kātabbā)|

puraijātapac‍cayādi

30. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu nauganthānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, daumanassaṃ  uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu ganthānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ  – vatthu ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi, āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

kammapac‍cayau

31. nauganthau  dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – nauganthā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – nauganthā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauganthā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ ganthānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nauganthā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākapac‍cayādi

32. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

33. ganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

nauganthau  dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ  (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu ganthānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau  dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā nauganthassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

atthipac‍cayau

34. ganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)|

ganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – ganthā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ganthā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthau dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (3)

35. nauganthau dhammau nauganthassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

nauganthau dhammau ganthassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātā – nauganthā khandhā ganthānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, vatthu ganthānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nauganthau  dhammau ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nauganthau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ ganthānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰…| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti; vatthu ganthānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

36. ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – sīlabbataparāmāsau kāyaganthau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā abhijjhākāyaganthassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| sahajātau – sīlabbataparāmāsau kāyaganthau ca vatthu ca abhijjhākāyaganthassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā nauganthassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – nauganthau aikau khandhau ca ganthau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātā – ganthā ca vatthu ca nauganthānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – ganthā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ganthā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ganthā ca kabaḷīkārau  āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ganthā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthau ca nauganthau ca dhammā ganthassa ca nauganthassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nauganthau aikau khandhau ca sīlabbataparāmāsau kāyaganthau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ abhijjhākāyaganthassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰…| sahajātau – sīlabbataparāmāsau kāyaganthau ca vatthu ca abhijjhākāyaganthassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (3)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

62. ganthasampayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ganthasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – ganthasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)
