ganthasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā laubhau ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… daumanassasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā paṭighañ‍ca…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

63. ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ganthavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – ganthavippayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

ganthavippayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ganthasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ laubhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭighaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā| (2)

ganthasampayuttañ‍ca ganthavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ganthasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ laubhasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca laubhañ‍ca  saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… daumanassasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca paṭighañ‍ca saṃsaṭṭhā tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)|

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

64. haituyā cha, ārammaṇai cha, adhipatiyā cha (sabbattha cha), vipākai aikaṃ, āhārai cha…pai॰… avigatai cha|

anulaumaṃ|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

nahaitupac‍cayau

65. ganthavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ganthavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati  nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ ganthavippayuttaṃ…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai saṃsaṭṭhau vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau (saṃkhittaṃ)|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

66. nahaituyā  aikaṃ, naadhipatiyā cha, napuraijātai cha, napacchājātai cha, naāsaivanai cha, nakammai cattāri, navipākai cha, najhānai aikaṃ, namaggai aikaṃ, navippayuttai cha|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

67. haitupac‍cayā naadhipatiyā cha, napuraijātai cha, napacchājātai cha, naāsaivanai cha, nakammai cattāri, navipākai cha, navippayuttai cha|

4. pac‍cayapac‍canīyānulaumaṃ

68. nahaitupac‍cayā  ārammaṇai aikaṃ, anantarai aikaṃ…pai॰… avigatai aikaṃ|

6. sampayuttavārau

(sampayuttavārau saṃsaṭṭhavārasadisau)|

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

69. ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthasampayuttau  dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthasampayuttā haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau haitu laubhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatau haitu paṭighassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthasampayuttā  haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau haitu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatau haitu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

70. ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthavippayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ  haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

71. ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau haitu ca laubhau ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatau haitu ca paṭighañ‍ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau haitu ca laubhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatau haitu ca paṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau haitu ca laubhau ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatau haitu ca paṭighañ‍ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

72. ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (tīsupi mūlā pucchitabbā) ganthasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha ganthavippayuttā khandhā uppaj‍janti, ganthasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti, daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

73. ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ  katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā ganthavippayuttai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ganthavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca paṭighañ‍ca anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati, vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, caitaupariyañāṇaina ganthavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… ganthavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… taṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati… diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati  (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ganthavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca paṭighañ‍ca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

74. ganthasampayuttau  ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca daumanassasahagatai khandhai ca paṭighañ‍ca ārabbha ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca daumanassasahagatai khandhai ca paṭighañ‍ca ārabbha ganthavippayuttā khandhā uppaj‍janti, diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca daumanassasahagatai khandhai ca paṭighañ‍ca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

75. ganthasampayuttau  dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – ganthasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – ganthasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – ganthasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – ganthasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatādhipati laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatādhipati paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – ganthasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|(3)

76. ganthavippayuttau  dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ganthavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā assādaiti  abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā ganthavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – ganthavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ganthavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā ganthasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati… diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ganthavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

77. ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā ganthasampayuttakā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlā pucchitabbā) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau uppaj‍jati| (mūlā pucchitabbā) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai  khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

anantarapac‍cayau

78. ganthasampayuttau  dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā ganthasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ganthasampayuttā  khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

79. ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā ganthavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ  pacchimānaṃ ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

80. ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā  purimā daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca pacchimānaṃ  pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlā pucchitabbā) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

81. ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

upanissayapac‍cayau

82. ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, tīṇipi  upanissayā) ganthasampayuttā khandhā ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ, tīṇipi upanissayā) ganthasampayuttā khandhā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

83. ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti… mānaṃ jappaiti… sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ … rāgaṃ… dausaṃ… mauhaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti… pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… pañ‍ñā, rāgau…pai॰… patthanā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya… rāgassa… dausassa… mauhassa… mānassa… patthanāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… rāgaṃ…pai॰… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ rāgassa… dausassa … mauhassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (tīṇi upanissayā); saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… rāgaṃ… dausaṃ… mauhaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… pañ‍ñā… rāgau… dausau… mauhau… mānau… patthanā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

84. ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau …pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhassa ca paṭighassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau  ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa  ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

puraijātapac‍cayau

85. ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati, vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa ca paṭighassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ  laubhassa ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

pacchājātapac‍cayau

ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – ganthasampayuttā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā caitanā laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatā  caitanā paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| nānākkhaṇikā – ganthasampayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthasampayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ganthasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca  rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

89. ganthavippayuttau  dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – ganthavippayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – ganthavippayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

92. ganthasampayuttau  ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

94. ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, vibhajitabbaṃ)| (1)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagataṃ paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayuttau rāgau…pai॰… diṭṭhi…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, vatthu ganthasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthavippayuttau dhammau ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau  – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭighaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ  atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca  uppaj‍janti, vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca daumanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

95. ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – ganthasampayuttau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau aikau khandhau ca laubhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… daumanassasahagatau aikau khandhau ca paṭighañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (1)

ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca laubhassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca paṭighassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca daumanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ‍ca  puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ganthasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ganthasampayuttau ca ganthavippayuttau ca dhammā ganthasampayuttassa ca ganthavippayuttassa ca dhammassa  atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau aikau khandhau ca laubhau  ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – daumanassasahagatau aikau khandhau ca paṭighañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – daumanassasahagatau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (3)

20. nahaitupac‍cayā ārammaṇai cattāri, anantarai cattāri, samanantarai cattāri…pai॰… maggai tīṇi, avigatai cattāri|

5. saṃsaṭṭhavārau

1-4. pac‍cayacatuk‍kaṃ

21. nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau nīvaraṇau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ uddhac‍canīvaraṇaṃ avij‍jānīvaraṇaṃ (cak‍kaṃ| sabbaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ vitthāraitabbaṃ)|

22. haituyā nava, ārammaṇai nava (sabbattha nava), vipākai aikaṃ…pai॰… avigatai nava|

anulaumaṃ|

23. nīvaraṇaṃ  dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau nīvaraṇau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ avij‍jānīvaraṇaṃ, uddhac‍canīvaraṇaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ avij‍jānīvaraṇaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)|

24. nahaituyā cattāri, naadhipatiyā nava, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai nava, najhānai aikaṃ, namaggai aikaṃ, navippayuttai nava|

pac‍canīyaṃ|

6. sampayuttavārau

(aivaṃ itarai dvai gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāraupi kātabbau|)

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

25. nīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nīvaraṇau  dhammau nīvaraṇassa ca naunīvaraṇassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ nīvaraṇānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – naunīvaraṇā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

26. nīvaraṇau  dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇai ārabbha nīvaraṇā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) nīvaraṇai ārabbha naunīvaraṇā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) nīvaraṇai ārabbha nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

27. naunīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā naunīvaraṇai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai samudāciṇṇai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naunīvaraṇai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina naunīvaraṇacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… naunīvaraṇā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naunīvaraṇau  dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naunīvaraṇai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi …pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| (2)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa ca naunīvaraṇassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naunīvaraṇai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

nīvaraṇau  ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā nīvaraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (ārabbha  kātabbā)|

adhipatipac‍cayau

28. nīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – nīvaraṇai garuṃ katvā nīvaraṇā uppaj‍janti… tīṇi (ārammaṇasadisaṃ)| (3)

29. naunīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naunīvaraṇai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – naunīvaraṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naunīvaraṇai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – naunīvaraṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa ca naunīvaraṇassa  ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naunīvaraṇai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – naunīvaraṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ nīvaraṇānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

nīvaraṇau  ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā nīvaraṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyaiva)|

anantarapac‍cayau

30. nīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nīvaraṇā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā nīvaraṇā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naunīvaraṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nīvaraṇā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā nīvaraṇā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

31. naunīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā naunīvaraṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naunīvaraṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… niraudhā vuṭṭhahantassa naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ ) purimā purimā naunīvaraṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā nīvaraṇānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ  pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā naunīvaraṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā nīvaraṇānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

32. nīvaraṇau ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā nīvaraṇassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naunīvaraṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇānañ‍ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

33. nīvaraṇau  dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

upanissayapac‍cayau

34. nīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – nīvaraṇāni nīvaraṇānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

35. naunīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa  dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… jhānaṃ uppādaiti, vipassanaṃ…pai॰… maggaṃ…pai॰… abhiñ‍ñaṃ…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ…pai॰… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā  …pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya, rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (tīṇi upanissayā)| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa ca naunīvaraṇassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ  upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

nīvaraṇau  ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā nīvaraṇassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā nīvaraṇānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

puraijātapac‍cayau

36. naunīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati…pai॰… tīṇi (puraijātaṃ ārammaṇasadisaṃ kusalākusalassa vibhajitabbaṃ)|

pacchājāta-āsaivanapac‍cayā

37. nīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

kammapac‍cayau

38. naunīvaraṇau  dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – naunīvaraṇā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – naunīvaraṇā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) naunīvaraṇā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) naunīvaraṇā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ nīvaraṇānañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākapac‍cayādi

39. naunīvaraṇau  dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

40. nīvaraṇau  dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (aivaṃ avasaisā cattāri pañhā kātabbā)|

atthipac‍cayau

41. nīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ thinamiddhanīvaraṇassa uddhac‍canīvaraṇassa avij‍jānīvaraṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (1)

nīvaraṇau dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (aivaṃ nīvaraṇamūlai tīṇi )| (3)

42. naunīvaraṇau  dhammau naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

naunīvaraṇau dhammau nīvaraṇassa ca naunīvaraṇassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ) (3)

43. nīvaraṇau ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā nīvaraṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – kāmacchandanīvaraṇañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā thinamiddhanīvaraṇassa uddhac‍canīvaraṇassa avij‍jānīvaraṇassa atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; kāmacchandanīvaraṇañ‍ca vatthu ca thinamiddhanīvaraṇassa uddhac‍canīvaraṇassa avij‍jānīvaraṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇau ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā naunīvaraṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – naunīvaraṇau aikau khandhau ca nīvaraṇā ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… nīvaraṇā ca vatthu ca naunīvaraṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; nīvaraṇā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nīvaraṇā ca sampayuttakā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nīvaraṇau ca naunīvaraṇau ca dhammā nīvaraṇassa ca naunīvaraṇassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – naunīvaraṇau aikau khandhau ca kāmacchandanīvaraṇañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ thinamiddhanīvaraṇassa uddhac‍canīvaraṇassa avij‍jānīvaraṇassa  ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… kāmacchandanīvaraṇañ‍ca  vatthu ca thinamiddhanīvaraṇassa uddhac‍canīvaraṇassa avij‍jānīvaraṇassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cak‍kaṃ)| (3)

67. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – rāgaṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; diṭṭhiṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; vicikicchaṃ ārabbha vicikicchā…pai॰… diṭṭhi…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; uddhac‍caṃ ārabbha uddhac‍caṃ uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi…pai॰… vicikicchā, daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; daumanassaṃ ārabbha daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; diṭṭhi  …pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ uppaj‍jati| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā nīvaraṇasampayuttai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti; nīvaraṇasampayuttai khandhai anic‍catau dukkhatau anattatau vipassati, caitaupariyañāṇaina nīvaraṇasampayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti; nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

68. nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā  vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nīvaraṇavippayuttai khandhai anic‍catau dukkhatau anattatau vipassati, dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati (yāva āvaj‍janāya)| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nīvaraṇavippayuttai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| (2)

adhipatipac‍cayau

69. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati; diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti…pai॰…| sahajātādhipati – nīvaraṇasampayuttādhipati nīvaraṇasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – nīvaraṇasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) nīvaraṇasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

70. nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – nīvaraṇavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānaṃ…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nīvaraṇavippayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

anantarapac‍cayau

71. nīvaraṇasampayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (idha purimā purimāti natthi)| (2)

(mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimā purimā nīvaraṇavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nīvaraṇavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āvaj‍janā nīvaraṇasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

72. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

upanissayapac‍cayau

73. nīvaraṇasampayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – rāgaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; dausaṃ… mauhaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya  pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; rāgau…pai॰… patthanā rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… jhānaṃ…pai॰… vipassanaṃ… maggaṃ… abhiñ‍ñaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti; dausaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti; rāgau…pai॰… patthanā saddhāya  …pai॰… pañ‍ñāya… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

74. nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… maggaṃ…pai॰… abhiñ‍ñaṃ…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya…pai॰… maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya  pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ rāgassa… dausassa… mauhassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

puraijātapac‍cayau

75. nīvaraṇavippayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau dukkhatau anattatau vipassati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu nīvaraṇavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau… dausau… mauhau…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu nīvaraṇasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

76. nīvaraṇasampayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… dvai, āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… dvai|

kammapac‍cayādi

77. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| nānākkhaṇikā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) nīvaraṇasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā (saṃkhittaṃ)| vipākapac‍cayā… aikaṃ|

āhārapac‍cayādi

78. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… dvai|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

79. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu nīvaraṇasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

atthipac‍cayau

80. nīvaraṇasampayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇasampayuttau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰…| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau  dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa ca nīvaraṇavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – nīvaraṇasampayuttau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

81. nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau…pai॰… diṭṭhi…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; vatthu nīvaraṇasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

82. nīvaraṇasampayuttau ca nīvaraṇavippayuttau ca dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – nīvaraṇasampayuttau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca  vatthu ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau ca nīvaraṇavippayuttau ca dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ  rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – nīvaraṇasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

83. haituyā  cattāri, ārammaṇai cattāri, adhipatiyā pañ‍ca, anantarai cattāri, samanantarai cattāri, sahajātai pañ‍ca, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai dvai, nissayai satta, upanissayai cattāri, puraijātai dvai, pacchājātai dvai, āsaivanai dvai, kammai cattāri, vipākai aikaṃ, āhārai cattāri, indriyai cattāri, jhānai cattāri, maggai cattāri, sampayuttai dvai, vippayuttai tīṇi, atthiyā satta, natthiyā cattāri, vigatai cattāri, avigatai satta|

anulaumaṃ|

pac‍canīyuddhārau

84. nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau … upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa ca nīvaraṇavippayuttassa ca dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

85. nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau … pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nīvaraṇavippayuttau dhammau nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau ca nīvaraṇavippayuttau ca dhammā nīvaraṇasampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| (1)

nīvaraṇasampayuttau ca nīvaraṇavippayuttau ca dhammā nīvaraṇavippayuttassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| (2)

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

86. nahaituyā satta, naārammaṇai satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantarai satta, nasamanantarai satta, nasahajātai pañ‍ca, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai pañ‍ca, nanissayai pañ‍ca, naupanissayai satta, napuraijātai cha…pai॰… namaggai satta, nasampayuttai pañ‍ca, navippayuttai cattāri, nauatthiyā cattāri, naunatthiyā satta, nauvigatai satta, nauavigatai cattāri|

pac‍canīyaṃ|

haitudukaṃ

87. haitupac‍cayā naārammaṇai cattāri, naadhipatiyā cattāri, naanantarai cattāri, nasamanantarai  cattāri, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai dvai, naupanissayai cattāri…pai॰… namaggai cattāri, nasampayuttai dvai, navippayuttai dvai, naunatthiyā cattāri, nauvigatai cattāri|

19. nauparāmāsau dhammau nauparāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā… uddhac‍caṃ… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni  …pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; ariyā nauparāmāsai pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauparāmāsai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā… uddhac‍caṃ… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina nauparāmāsacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… nauparāmāsā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauparāmāsau dhammau parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… taṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauparāmāsai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

20. parāmāsau ca nauparāmāsau ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – parāmāsañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha parāmāsau uppaj‍jati… tīṇi|

22. nauparāmāsau dhammau nauparāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… phalaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauparāmāsai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nauparāmāsādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

nauparāmāsau dhammau parāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauparāmāsai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – nauparāmāsādhipati parāmāsassa adhipatipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (2)

nauparāmāsau dhammau parāmāsassa ca nauparāmāsassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā …pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ nauparāmāsai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – nauparāmāsādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ parāmāsassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

parāmāsau  ca nauparāmāsau ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – parāmāsañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai garuṃ katvā parāmāsau… tīṇi|

anantarapac‍cayau

23. parāmāsau dhammau parāmāsassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau parāmāsau pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimau purimau parāmāsau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nauparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; parāmāsau vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimau purimau parāmāsau pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

24. nauparāmāsau dhammau nauparāmāsassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā nauparāmāsā khandhā pacchimānaṃ  pacchimānaṃ nauparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… anulaumaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā nauparāmāsā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā parāmāsassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā nauparāmāsā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā parāmāsassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

25. parāmāsau ca nauparāmāsau ca dhammā parāmāsassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau parāmāsau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ)  purimau purimau parāmāsau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nauparāmāsānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; parāmāsau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimau purimau parāmāsau ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa parāmāsassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

27. parāmāsau dhammau parāmāsassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – parāmāsau parāmāsassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

nauparāmāsau dhammau parāmāsassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

50. parāmāsasampayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – parāmāsasampayuttai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

parāmāsavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – parāmāsavippayuttai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

parāmāsasampayuttañ‍ca parāmāsavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – parāmāsasampayuttai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

63. parāmāsasampayuttau  dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – parāmāsasampayuttā  haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) parāmāsasampayuttā haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) parāmāsasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca  rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

64. parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – rāgaṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati; parāmāsasampayuttai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| (1)

parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā parāmāsasampayuttai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, parāmāsasampayuttai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; caitaupariyañāṇaina parāmāsasampayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

65. parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā  vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā parāmāsavippayuttai pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayuttai khandhai  anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina parāmāsavippayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… parāmāsavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayuttai khandhai assādaiti abhinandati| taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| (2)

adhipatipac‍cayau

66. parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati, parāmāsasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti  abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa ca parāmāsavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – parāmāsasampayuttādhipati  sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

67. parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati, pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – parāmāsavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati, pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ parāmāsavippayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| (2)

anantara-samanantarapac‍cayā

68. parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsasampayuttau  dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – parāmāsasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

69. parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā parāmāsavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ  pacchimānaṃ parāmāsavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsavippayuttau  dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – āvaj‍janā parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sahajātapac‍cayādi

70. parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… dvai… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… satta|

upanissayapac‍cayau

71. parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau… mauhau… patthanā parāmāsasampayuttassa rāgassa… mauhassa… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsasampayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – parāmāsasampayuttaṃ rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti; parāmāsasampayuttaṃ mauhaṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau… mauhau… patthanā saddhāya  …pai॰… pañ‍ñāya, rāgassa… dausassa… mauhassa… mānassa… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

72. parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti …pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ, rāgaṃ…pai॰… mānaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… pañ‍ñā, rāgau…pai॰… mānau… patthanā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya, rāgassa…pai॰… mānassa… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ parāmāsasampayuttassa rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

puraijātapac‍cayau

73. parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsavippayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsavippayuttau rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa  …pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu parāmāsavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

parāmāsavippayuttau dhammau parāmāsasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāsasampayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu parāmāsasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)
