ārammaṇapac‍cayau

28. sārammaṇau  dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, sārammaṇai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; caitaupariyañāṇaina sārammaṇacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… sārammaṇā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

29. anārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ  suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… anārammaṇā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

adhipatipac‍cayau

30. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ garuṃ…pai॰… sārammaṇai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – sārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – sārammaṇādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – sārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

31. anārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti; nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (1)

anantarapac‍cayādi

32. sārammaṇau  dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā sārammaṇā…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… satta (paṭic‍cavārai sahajātasadisā)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… cha (paṭic‍cavārai añ‍ñamañ‍ñasadisaṃ)… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… satta (pac‍cayavārai nissayasadisau)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

33. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti| sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ, rāgaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ  uppādaiti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati| saddhā…pai॰… pañ‍ñā, rāgau…pai॰… patthanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya, rāgassa…pai॰… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – utuṃ, bhaujanaṃ, saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati| utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

puraijātapac‍cayau

34. anārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

35. sārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ|

sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ|

kammapac‍cayau

36. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sārammaṇā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – sārammaṇā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sārammaṇā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – sārammaṇā caitanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – sārammaṇā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – sārammaṇā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipāka-āhārapac‍cayā

37. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

sārammaṇau  dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

anārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

indriyapac‍cayau

38. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

anārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anārammaṇau  dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sārammaṇau ca anārammaṇau  ca dhammā sārammaṇassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

jhānapac‍cayādi

39. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi, maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi, sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

40. sārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

anārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ  vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

atthipac‍cayau

41. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sārammaṇau aikau khandhau tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sārammaṇau  dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (3)

42. anārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātaṃ – aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva  asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

anārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu sārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

43. sārammaṇau ca anārammaṇau ca dhammā sārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… sārammaṇau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

sārammaṇau  ca anārammaṇau ca dhammā anārammaṇassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – sārammaṇā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – sārammaṇā khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā  – sārammaṇā  khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

44. haituyā tīṇi, ārammaṇai dvai, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantarai aikaṃ, samanantarai aikaṃ, sahajātai satta, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nissayai satta, upanissayai dvai, puraijātai aikaṃ, pacchājātai aikaṃ, āsaivanai aikaṃ, kammai tīṇi, vipākai tīṇi, āhārai cattāri, indriyai cha, jhānai tīṇi, maggai tīṇi, sampayuttai aikaṃ, vippayuttai dvai, atthiyā satta, natthiyā aikaṃ, vigatai aikaṃ, avigatai satta|

pac‍canīyuddhārau

45. sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

sārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sārammaṇau dhammau sārammaṇassa ca anārammaṇassa ca dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

46. anārammaṇau dhammau anārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

anārammaṇau  dhammau sārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

sārammaṇau  ca anārammaṇau ca dhammā sārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| (1)

sārammaṇau ca anārammaṇau ca dhammā anārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| (2)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

47. nahaituyā satta, naārammaṇai satta…pai॰… nasamanantarai satta, nasahajātai cha, na añ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nanissayai cha, naupanissayai satta, napuraijātai satta, napacchājātai satta…pai॰… namaggai satta, nasampayuttai cha, navippayuttai pañ‍ca, nauatthiyā cattāri, naunatthiyā satta, nauvigatai satta, nauavigatai cattāri|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

48. haitupac‍cayā naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā…pai॰… nasamanantarai tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai aikaṃ, naupanissayai tīṇi…pai॰… namaggai tīṇi, nasampayuttai aikaṃ, navippayuttai aikaṃ, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

4. pac‍cayapac‍canīyānulaumaṃ

49. nahaitupac‍cayā ārammaṇai dvai, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantarai aikaṃ (anulaumamātikā kātabbā)…pai॰… avigatai satta|

sārammaṇadukaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ|

56. cittadukaṃ

1. paṭic‍cavārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

50. cittaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ| (1)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai paṭic‍ca aikau khandhau cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭic‍ca…pai॰…| (1)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – naucittai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ  khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai paṭic‍ca aikau khandhau cittañ‍ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

cittañ‍ca naucittañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā  – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca naucittā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

51. cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

naucittaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā| (1)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – naucittai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai paṭic‍ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

cittañ‍ca  naucittañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca naucittā khandhā| (1) (saṃkhittaṃ)|

naucittaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai …pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā) vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai naucittai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca  dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

cittañ‍ca naucittañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca naucittā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ cittañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai naucittai khandhai pac‍cayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ pac‍cayā  cittaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ| (2)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ| (3)

cittañ‍ca naucittañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā naucittā khandhā; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā naucittā khandhā, cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ ca…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1) (saṃkhittaṃ|)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

66. nahaituyā pañ‍ca, naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā pañ‍ca, naanantarai tīṇi, nasamanantarai  tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai tīṇi, naupanissayai tīṇi, napuraijātai pañ‍ca, napacchājātai pañ‍ca, naāsaivanai pañ‍ca, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai pañ‍ca, naāhārai aikaṃ, naindriyai aikaṃ, najhānai pañ‍ca, namaggai pañ‍ca, nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai  pañ‍ca, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

5. saṃsaṭṭhavārau

1-4. pac‍cayānulaumādi

haitupac‍cayau

69. cittaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai saṃsaṭṭhau aikau khandhau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

naucittaṃ  dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau cittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – naucittai khandhai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

naucittaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

cittañ‍ca naucittañ‍ca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau naucittau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – naucittaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)|

haituyā pañ‍ca, ārammaṇai pañ‍ca, adhipatiyā pañ‍ca (sabbattha  pañ‍ca), avigatai pañ‍ca (saṃkhittaṃ)|

nahaituyā  pañ‍ca, naadhipatiyā pañ‍ca, napuraijātai pañ‍ca, napacchājātai pañ‍ca, naāsaivanai pañ‍ca, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai pañ‍ca, najhānai pañ‍ca, namaggai pañ‍ca, navippayuttai pañ‍ca|

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

70. naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – naucittā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ  khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – naucittā haitū cittassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

naucittau dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – naucittā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

71. cittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittaṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittaṃ ārabbha naucittā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittaṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

72. naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati, pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā  maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; ariyā naucittai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naucittai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina naucittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… naucittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā…pai॰… (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ, imaṃ nānaṃ) rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… naucittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa…pai॰… āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittau dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ datvā…pai॰… (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ, imaṃ  nānaṃ), rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… naucittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa…pai॰… āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati… tīṇi|

adhipatipac‍cayau

73. cittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (1)

cittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā  naucittā khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – cittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittau  dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

74. naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati, pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ  katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti| phalaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naucittai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – naucittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (dvaipi gamanā paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ| ārammaṇādhipati sahajātādhipati kātabbā)| (2)

cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… ārammaṇādhipati (tīṇipi garukārammaṇā kātabbā, ārammaṇādhipatiyaiva)|

anantarapac‍cayādi

75. cittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naucittānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cittaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittau  dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

76. naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā naucittā khandhā…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (imai  dvai pūraitukāmaina kātabbā, purimagamanasadisaṃ)|

cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimaṃ purimaṃ cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ naucittānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) purimaṃ purimaṃ cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍cavārasadisā)… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca (pac‍cayavārasadisā)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

77. cittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – cittaṃ cittassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti …pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā  upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (imai dvaipi pūraitukāmaina sabbattha kātabbā, paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)|

cittau  ca naucittau ca dhammā cittassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

puraijātapac‍cayau

78. naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu naucittānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa  …pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu cittassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittau dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ  uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

79. cittau  dhammau naucittassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā naucittassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

cittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

kammapac‍cayau

80. naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – naucittā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – naucittā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā  ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – naucittā caitanā cittassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – naucittā caitanā vipākassa cittassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittau dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – naucittā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – naucittā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākapac‍cayādi

81. cittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca| naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

82. cittau  dhammau naucittassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – naucittā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pai॰… naucittā khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… vatthu naucittānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – naucittā khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittau dhammau cittassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittau  dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

cittau ca naucittau ca dhammā naucittassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

atthipac‍cayau

83. cittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naucittau dhammau naucittassa dhammassa  atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naucittau  dhammau cittassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātā – naucittā khandhā cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… (puraijātasadisaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

naucittau dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – naucittau aikau khandhau dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittau aikau khandhau…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ…pai॰… (puraijātasadisaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

84. cittau  ca naucittau ca dhammā naucittassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – naucittau aikau khandhau ca cittañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātaṃ – cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca naucittānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭisandhikkhaṇaipi dvai)| sahajātaṃ – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātaṃ – cittañ‍ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭisandhikkhaṇaipi dvai)| pacchājātaṃ – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātaṃ – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā  ca khandhā kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātaṃ – cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

naucittau dhammau cittassa ca naucittassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

haitupac‍cayau

92. caitasikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai paṭic‍ca aikau khandhau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – caitasikai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ| (2)

caitasikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

93. acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ  paṭic‍ca cittaṃ, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca  caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikā khandhā| (2)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

94. caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (1)

caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – caitasikai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, caitasikai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca  cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ  aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca aikau khandhau cittañ‍ca| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

95. caitasikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – caitasikai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

96. acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (1)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikā khandhā| (2)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ  khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (1)

caitasikañ‍ca  acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

caitasikañ‍ca  acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (3)

nahaitupac‍cayau

99. caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai  uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai caitasikai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai  …pai॰…| (3)

100. acaitasikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰…| (1)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

101. caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai  khandhai  ca…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai caitasikai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, ahaitukai caitasikai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca  dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai caitasikaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (3)

naārammaṇapac‍cayau

102. caitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – caitasikai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

acaitasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai  …pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

caitasikañ‍ca acaitasikañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca acaitasikau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – caitasikai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, caitasikai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā, saṃkhittaṃ)|

136. caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā caitasikassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau…pai॰… caitasikau aikau khandhau ca  vatthu ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – caitasikau aikau khandhau ca cittañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai) dvaipi kātabbā| (1)

caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā acaitasikassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… caitasikā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; caitasikā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā  – caitasikā khandhā ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭisandhikkhaṇai tīṇipi  kātabbā)| pacchājātā – caitasikā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – caitasikā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – caitasikā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

caitasikau ca acaitasikau ca dhammā caitasikassa ca acaitasikassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – caitasikau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… (paṭisandhiyā dvai kātabbā)| (3)

158. cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati  nahaitupac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍casadisā)|

cittavippayuttaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittavippayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukā cittasampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasampayuttau ca cittavippayuttau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā ahaitukā cittasampayuttakā khandhā, mahābhūtai pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

cittasampayuttañ‍ca cittavippayuttañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… ahaitukaṃ cittasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (aivaṃ dvai pañhā pavattipaṭisandhi kātabbā| saṃkhittaṃ|)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

159. nahaituyā  nava, naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai tīṇi, nasamanantarai tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai tīṇi, naupanissayai tīṇi, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai cattāri, navipākai nava, naāhārai aikaṃ, naindriyai aikaṃ, najhānai cattāri, namaggai nava, nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai dvai, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

160. haitupac‍cayā naārammaṇai tīṇi…pai॰… nakammai tīṇi…pai॰… navippayuttai aikaṃ, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

4. pac‍cayapac‍canīyānulaumaṃ

161. nahaitupac‍cayā ārammaṇai tīṇi…pai॰… maggai tīṇi…pai॰… avigatai nava|

4. nissayavārau

(nissayavārau pac‍cayavārasadisau|)

5. saṃsaṭṭhavārau

1-4. pac‍cayānulaumādi

162. cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau cittasampayuttau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasampayuttaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…|

haituyā aikaṃ, ārammaṇai aikaṃ, adhipatiyā aikaṃ (sabbattha aikaṃ), avigatai aikaṃ|

nahaituyā  aikaṃ, naadhipatiyā aikaṃ, napuraijātai aikaṃ, napacchājātai aikaṃ, naāsaivanai aikaṃ, nakammai aikaṃ, navipākai aikaṃ, najhānai aikaṃ, namaggai aikaṃ, navippayuttai aikaṃ|

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

163. cittasampayuttau  dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasampayuttā haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

164. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| pahīnai  kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti| pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti| cittasampayuttai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| caitaupariyañāṇaina cittasampayuttasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti| ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ  naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… cittasampayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

165. cittavippayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ cittavippayuttai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… cittavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

adhipatipac‍cayau

166. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| pubbai…pai॰… jhānā…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti, cittasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – cittasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa  dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – cittasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasampayuttau  dhammau cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātādhipati – cittasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

167. cittavippayuttau  dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ cittavippayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (1)

anantarapac‍cayādi

168. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā cittasampayuttā khandhā…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… satta (paṭic‍casadisā, pañhāghaṭanā natthi)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… cha (paṭic‍casadisā)… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… satta (pac‍cayavārasadisā, pañhāghaṭanā natthi)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

169. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau  …pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… patthanaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… pāṇaṃ hanati…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittavippayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ upanissāya  dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

puraijātapac‍cayau

170. cittavippayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā  rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

171. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (saṃkhittaṃ) aikaṃ, āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau … aikaṃ|

kammapac‍cayau

172. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – cittasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – cittasampayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – cittasampayuttā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – cittasampayuttā caitanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasampayuttau  dhammau cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – cittasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – cittasampayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

vipākāhārapac‍cayā

cittavippayuttau  dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa  kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

indriyapac‍cayādi

174. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

cittavippayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittavippayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ…pai॰…| (2)

cittasampayuttau ca cittavippayuttau ca dhammā cittasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau …pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca sukhindriyañ‍ca…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca dukkhindriyañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

175. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

cittavippayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ  …pai॰… vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

atthipac‍cayau

176. cittasampayuttau  dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… aikaṃ (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (1)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (3)

177. cittavippayuttau  dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

cittavippayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… (puraijātasadisaṃ)| (2)

178. cittasampayuttau ca cittavippayuttau ca dhammā cittasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… cittasampayuttau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

cittasampayuttau ca cittavippayuttau ca dhammā cittavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – cittasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| pacchājātā – cittasampayuttakā khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – cittasampayuttakā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

179. haituyā  tīṇi, ārammaṇai dvai, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantarai aikaṃ, samanantarai aikaṃ, sahajātai satta, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nissayai satta, upanissayai dvai, puraijātai aikaṃ, pacchājātai aikaṃ, āsaivanai aikaṃ, kammai tīṇi, vipākai tīṇi, āhārai cattāri, indriyai cha, jhānai tīṇi, maggai tīṇi, sampayuttai aikaṃ, vippayuttai dvai, atthiyā satta, natthiyā aikaṃ, vigatai aikaṃ, avigatai satta|

anulaumaṃ|

pac‍canīyuddhārau

180. cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasampayuttau dhammau cittasampayuttassa ca cittavippayuttassa ca dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

181. cittavippayuttau dhammau cittavippayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittavippayuttau dhammau  cittasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasampayuttau ca cittavippayuttau ca dhammā cittasampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| (1)

cittasampayuttau ca cittavippayuttau ca dhammā cittavippayuttassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| (2)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

182. nahaituyā  satta, naārammaṇai satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantarai satta, nasamanantarai satta, nasahajātai cha, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nanissayai cha, naupanissayai satta, napuraijātai satta (sabbattha satta), nasampayuttai cha, navippayuttai pañ‍ca, nauatthiyā cattāri, naunatthiyā satta, nauvigatai satta, nauavigatai cattāri|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

183. haitupac‍cayā naārammaṇai tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantarai tīṇi, nasamanantarai tīṇi, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai aikaṃ, naupanissayai tīṇi (sabbattha tīṇi), nasampayuttai aikaṃ, navippayuttai aikaṃ, naunatthiyā tīṇi, nauvigatai tīṇi|

184. nahaitupac‍cayā ārammaṇai dvai, adhipatiyā cattāri (anulaumamātikā kātabbā)…pai॰… avigatai satta|

186. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau  uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

187. naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ; cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

188. cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca  paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

189. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

190. naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

191. cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca  dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca  paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

192. haituyā nava, ārammaṇai nava, adhipatiyā pañ‍ca, anantarai nava, samanantarai nava, sahajātai nava, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai nava, nissayai nava, upanissayai nava, puraijātai pañ‍ca, āsaivanai pañ‍ca, kammai nava, vipākai nava, āhārai nava, indriyai nava, jhānai nava, maggai nava, sampayuttai nava (sabbattha nava), avigatai nava|

193. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

194. naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā kātabbā)| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā khandhā ca| (3)

195. cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca  naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca  naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

naārammaṇapac‍cayau

196. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, upādārūpaṃ| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (2)

197. naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vatthu, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ  paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca  naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā  – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

suddhaṃ

198. nahaituyā nava, naārammaṇai cha, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai cha, nasamanantarai cha, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, naupanissayai cha, napuraijātai nava, napacchājātai nava, naāsaivanai nava, nakammai cattāri, navipākai pañ‍ca, naāhārai aikaṃ, naindriyai aikaṃ, najhānai cha, namaggai nava, nasampayuttai cha, navippayuttai cha, naunatthiyā cha, nauvigatai cha|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

199. haitupac‍cayā naārammaṇai cha, naadhipatiyā nava…pai॰… nakammai tīṇi, navipākai pañ‍ca, nasampayuttai cha, navippayuttai pañ‍ca, naunatthiyā cha, nauvigatai cha|

4. pac‍cayapac‍canīyānulaumaṃ

200. nahaitupac‍cayā ārammaṇai nava, anantarai nava, samanantarai nava…pai॰… puraijātai pañ‍ca, āsaivanai pañ‍ca…pai॰… jhānai nava, maggai tīṇi…pai॰… avigatai  nava|

haitupac‍cayau

201. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)|

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (paṭic‍cavārasadisā)| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvai (paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)| (3)

202. cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi paṭic‍cavārasadisā)| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā  – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā cittaṃ  (paṭisandhikkhaṇai tīṇipi kātabbā paṭic‍cavārasadisā)| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā paṭic‍cavārasadisā)| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

203. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍cavārasadisā)|

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā, cittaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi)| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

204. cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai …pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai khandhai ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3) (saṃkhittaṃ)|

208. cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (2)

209. naucittasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)
