7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

210. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānā  haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānā haitū cittassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānā haitū cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

211. cittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ārabbha cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai  ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ārabbha cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

212. naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naucittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina naucittasamuṭṭhānacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… naucittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā maggā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ); cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ naucittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… naucittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā maggā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ), naucittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… naucittasamuṭṭhānā  khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (ārabbha kātabbā)|

adhipatipac‍cayau

213. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – cittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai garuṃ katvā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – cittasamuṭṭhānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (tīṇipi ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipatipi kātabbā)| (3)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati  – ariyā maggā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pai॰… naucittasamuṭṭhānai  khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti…pai॰… naucittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – naucittasamuṭṭhānādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā…pai॰… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhanti…pai॰… naucittasamuṭṭhānai khandhai garuṃ katvā…pai॰… cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati… tīṇi (ārammaṇādhipatiyaiva)|

anantara-samanantarapac‍cayā

214. cittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (vuṭṭhānaṃ natthi)|

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa…pai॰… niraudhā vuṭṭhahantassa naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (itarai dvai gaṇanā, imassa sadisāyaiva kātabbā)|

cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau  ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (tīṇi kātabbā, vuṭṭhānaṃ natthi)… samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

sahajātapac‍cayādi

215. cittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍cavārasadisaṃ)… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (pac‍cayavārasadisaṃ)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

216. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – (tīṇi pañhā kātabbā)| (3)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ cittaṃ cittassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya  dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ cittaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – utuṃ… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ cittaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; utu… bhaujanaṃ… saināsanaṃ cittaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau… tīṇi|

puraijātapac‍cayau

217. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cittasamuṭṭhānai rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cittasamuṭṭhānai rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa  ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cittasamuṭṭhānai rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya  sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| (3)

218. naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kāyaṃ, rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ …pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

219. cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ …pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca…pai॰…| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa  puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca…pai॰…| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānau  ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ ca…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca…pai॰…| (3)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

220. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā cittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā puraijātassa imassa cittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (iminākārainaiva pacchājātau vitthāraitabbau)… āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

kamma-vipākapac‍cayā

221. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – cittasamuṭṭhānā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā caitanā cittassa  kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – cittasamuṭṭhānā caitanā vipākassa cittassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – cittasamuṭṭhānā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – cittasamuṭṭhānā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

āhārapac‍cayau

222. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā cittassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… cittasamuṭṭhānau kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa naucittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

223. naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittasamuṭṭhānā  āhārā kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; naucittasamuṭṭhānau kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa naucittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) naucittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittasamuṭṭhānā āhārā  sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

224. cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānā ca naucittasamuṭṭhānā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ  cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānā ca naucittasamuṭṭhānā ca āhārā kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau imassa naucittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānā ca naucittasamuṭṭhānā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

indriyapac‍cayādi

225. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittasamuṭṭhānā  indriyā kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) naucittasamuṭṭhānā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai naucittasamuṭṭhānā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ…pai॰…| (3)

226. cittasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasamuṭṭhānā ca naucittasamuṭṭhānā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca sukhindriyañ‍ca…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca dukkhindriyañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānā ca naucittasamuṭṭhānā ca indriyā kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa …pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittasamuṭṭhānā ca naucittasamuṭṭhānā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ  khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; kāyindriyaṃ ca…pai॰…| (3)

jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca…pai॰…|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

227. cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

cittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

228. naucittasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cittaṃ vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – naucittasamuṭṭhānā khandhā puraijātassa imassa naucittasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ  (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

248. cittasahabhuñ‍ca  naucittasahabhuñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasahabhū dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasahabhuṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… cittasahabhuṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ, sabbai mahābhūtā)| (1)

cittasahabhuñ‍ca naucittasahabhuñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasahabhū dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasahabhū khandhai ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā naucittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasahabhū khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā cittaṃ| cittasahabhū khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā naucittasahabhu cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ, sabbai mahābhūtā)| (2)

cittasahabhuñ‍ca naucittasahabhuñ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasahabhū ca naucittasahabhū ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – cittasahabhuṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā  dvai khandhā cittasahabhu ca naucittasahabhu ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasahabhuṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai  khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ, sabbai mahābhūtā)| (3)

265. cittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa ca naucittasahabhussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā cittasahabhūnañ‍ca naucittasahabhūnañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

266. naucittasahabhū dhammau naucittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ naucittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cittaṃ vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātaṃ – cittaṃ puraijātassa imassa naucittasahabhussa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

naucittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittasahabhūnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa ca naucittasahabhussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ cittasahabhūnañ‍ca naucittasahabhūnañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

267. cittasahabhū  ca naucittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañ‍ca cittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

cittasahabhū ca naucittasahabhū ca dhammā naucittasahabhussa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañ‍ca naucittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ  rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai  …pai॰…| pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañ‍ca puraijātassa imassa naucittasahabhussa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasahabhū ca naucittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa ca naucittasahabhussa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañ‍ca cittasahabhūnañ‍ca naucittasahabhūnañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

atthipac‍cayau

268. cittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasahabhū aikau khandhau…pai॰… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (1)

naucittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ| (2)

naucittasahabhū dhammau cittasahabhussa ca naucittasahabhussa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

269. cittasahabhū  ca naucittasahabhū ca dhammā cittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… (sabbaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ  kātabbaṃ, sahajātaṃ puraijātampi)| (1)

cittasahabhū ca naucittasahabhū ca dhammā naucittasahabhussa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā…pai॰… cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañ‍ca naucittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca naucittasahabhūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭisandhikkhaṇai tīṇipi kātabbā)| pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca cittañ‍ca puraijātassa imassa naucittasahabhussa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa naucittasahabhussa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – cittasahabhū khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

285. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vatthu, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai  ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvai, saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ pac‍cayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (yāva mahābhūtā)| (1)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā) tīṇi| (3)

290. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā  – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (1)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca pac‍cayā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai tīṇipi kātabbā)| (2)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

291. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍casadisā)|

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (1)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… cittaṃ pac‍cayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (2)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai aikaṃ kātabbaṃ)| (3)

292. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvai kātabbā)| (1)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai khandhai ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ …pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai aikaṃ  kātabbaṃ)| (2)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai aikaṃ kātabbaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

300. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ  haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā haitū cittassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

301. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ārabbha cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānai khandhai ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰…| (saṃkhittaṃ| yathā cittasahabhūdukai ārammaṇaṃ aivaṃ kātabbaṃ, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ| navapi pañhā|)

adhipatipac‍cayau

302. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati… tīṇi  (dvaipi adhipatī kātabbā)| (3)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati… tīṇi (dvaipi adhipati kātabbā)| (3)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati| (aikāyaiva adhipati kātabbā, navapi pañhā| yathā cittasahabhūdukaṃ, aivaṃ kātabbaṃ, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)|

anantarapac‍cayādi

303. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (navapi pañhā cittasahabhūdukasadisā)… samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (paṭic‍casadisā)… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (paṭic‍casadisā)… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (pac‍cayasadisā)… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (navapi pañhā cittasahabhūdukasadisā, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)|

puraijātapac‍cayādi

304. naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ… tīṇi (cittasahabhūdukasadisā, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)|

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (cittasahabhūdukasadisā, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ| tīṇipi pacchājātā| dvai| aikamūlānaṃ aikā ghaṭanā)… āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

kammapac‍cayādi

305. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (cittasahabhūdukasadisā nin‍nānākaraṇā| tīṇipi sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā)… vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (cittasahabhūgamanasadisā, aikaṃyaiva kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ)… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava… jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

306. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa  sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)|

atthipac‍cayau

307. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisā)| cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisā)| (3)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (puraijātasadisaṃ puraijātaṃ kātabbaṃ| sabbaṃ saṃkhittaṃ| vitthāraitabbaṃ)| (1)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ (puraijātasadisaṃ, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)| (2)

naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau dhammau cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ  (puraijātasadisaṃ)| (3)

308. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau  ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau aikau khandhau ca cittañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (1)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā  ca cittañ‍ca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭisandhikkhaṇai  tīṇi kātabbā)| pacchājātā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca puraijātassa imassa naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānā khandhā ca cittañ‍ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau ca dhammā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca naucittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau…pai॰…| sahajātau – cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau aikau khandhau ca cittañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca dvin‍naṃ  khandhānaṃ cittassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, dvai khandhā ca…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (3)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

318. ajjhattikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ| (2)

ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

319. bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā, aikaṃ  mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca  cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

320. ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca bāhirā khandhā| (2)

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā  – paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

321. ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā| (1)

bāhiraṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca khandhā| (1)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

ajjhattikañ‍ca  bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

suddhaṃ

322. haituyā  nava, ārammaṇai pañ‍ca, adhipatiyā pañ‍ca, anantarai pañ‍ca, samanantarai pañ‍ca, sahajātai nava, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai pañ‍ca, nissayai nava, upanissayai pañ‍ca, puraijātai pañ‍ca, āsaivanai pañ‍ca, kammai nava, vipākai nava (sabbattha nava), sampayuttai pañ‍ca, vippayuttai nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā pañ‍ca, vigatai pañ‍ca, avigatai nava|

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

nahaitupac‍cayau

323. ajjhattikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhac‍casahagataṃ cittaṃ paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

324. bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai  …pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā) vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (1)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittaṃ ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ| (2)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai …pai॰… ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthuṃ paṭic‍ca cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā| (3)

325. ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukaṃ bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… ahaitukaṃ cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā bāhiraṃ kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca vatthuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca bāhirā khandhā, vicikicchāsahagatai uddhac‍casahagatai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca  paṭic‍ca vicikicchāsahagatau uddhac‍casahagatau mauhau| (2)

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti nahaitupac‍cayā – ahaitukapaṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ, dvai khandhai ca…pai॰…| (3)

naārammaṇapac‍cayau

326. ajjhattikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – cittaṃ paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (2)

ajjhattikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti naārammaṇapac‍cayā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca bāhiraṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ, bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca vatthu, aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… (yāva asañ‍ñasattā)| (1)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (2)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirai khandhai paṭic‍ca ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ| (3)

327. ajjhattikañ‍ca  bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca ajjhattikaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ| (1)

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati naārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai ca cittañ‍ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, cittañ‍ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvai kātabbā)|

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti naārammaṇapac‍cayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittañ‍ca sampayuttakai ca khandhai paṭic‍ca ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca kaṭattārūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

najhānapac‍cayau

328. ajjhattikaṃ  dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati najhānapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ paṭic‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰…|

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati najhānapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ…pai॰… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asañ‍ñasattānaṃ…pai॰…| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati najhānapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai khandhai paṭic‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti najhānapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ…pai॰…| (3)

ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati najhānapac‍cayā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagataṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca paṭic‍ca dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ (cak‍kaṃ)|

haitupac‍cayau

332. ajjhattikaṃ  dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā… tīṇi (paṭic‍casadisā)|

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā, yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā) vatthuṃ pac‍cayā  bāhirā khandhā| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai pac‍cayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ, dvai khandhai…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ pac‍cayā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… vatthuṃ pac‍cayā bāhirā khandhā| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai pac‍cayā cittaṃ, vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittaṃ (paṭisandhikkhaṇai dvaipi kātabbā)| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti ārammaṇapac‍cayā – vatthuṃ pac‍cayā cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā (paṭisandhikkhaṇai aikaṃ kātabbaṃ)| (3)

335. ajjhattikañ‍ca bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ pac‍cayā ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati ārammaṇapac‍cayā  – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai khandhai ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca pac‍cayā cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatai…pai॰…|

339. ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – cittaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā| (1)

bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ajjhattikau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhirai khandhai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā cittañ‍ca, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (3)

ajjhattikañ‍ca  bāhirañ‍ca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – bāhiraṃ aikaṃ khandhañ‍ca cittañ‍ca saṃsaṭṭhā dvai khandhā, dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)| haituyā pañ‍ca, ārammaṇai pañ‍ca, adhipatiyā pañ‍ca (sabbattha pañ‍ca), avigatai pañ‍ca (anulaumaṃ)|

ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭhau bāhirau dhammau uppaj‍jati nahaitupac‍cayā (aivaṃ pañ‍ca kātabbā, tīṇiyaiva mauhau)|

nahaituyā  pañ‍ca, naadhipatiyā pañ‍ca, napuraijātai pañ‍ca, napacchājātai pañ‍ca, naāsaivanai pañ‍ca, nakammai tīṇi, navipākai pañ‍ca, najhānai pañ‍ca, namaggai pañ‍ca, navippayuttai pañ‍ca (pac‍canīyaṃ)|

6. sampayuttavārau

(aivaṃ itarai dvai gaṇanāpi sampayuttavāraupi kātabbau|)

7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

340. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā haitū cittassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā haitū cittassa ajjhattikānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

341. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cittaṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cittaṃ  ārabbha bāhirā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) cittaṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; pubbai suciṇṇāni pac‍cavaikkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ…pai॰… phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti… nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ariyā bāhirai pahīnai kilaisai pac‍cavaikkhanti, vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai jānanti, rūpai…pai॰… vatthuṃ bāhirai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| caitaupariyañāṇaina bāhiracittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañ‍cāyatanaṃ viñ‍ñāṇañ‍cāyatanassa…pai॰… ākiñ‍cañ‍ñāyatanaṃ naivasañ‍ñānāsañ‍ñāyatanassa…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… bāhirā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti  abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānaṃ…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbaṃ kātabbaṃ) pubbai samudāciṇṇai…pai॰… rūpai…pai॰… vatthuṃ bāhirai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… bāhirā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

bāhirau  dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pac‍cavaikkhati assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbaṃ kātabbaṃ)| bāhirai khandhai anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati…pai॰… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ca sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰… bāhirā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

adhipatipac‍cayau

342. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| (1)

ajjhattikau  dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – cittaṃ garuṃ katvā bāhirā khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – cittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati – ajjhattikaṃ cittaṃ garuṃ katvā cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppaj‍janti| (3)

bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā…pai॰… tīṇi (dvai adhipatī tiṇṇampi kātabbā)| (3)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi (tiṇṇampi aikāyaiva adhipati)|

anantarapac‍cayādi

343. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimaṃ purimaṃ cittaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa cittassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā bāhirā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… tīṇi (tiṇṇampi aikasadisā)|

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi, samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava, sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava (paṭic‍casadisā), añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca (paṭic‍casadisā), nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava, (pac‍cayavārasadisā)|

upanissayapac‍cayau

344. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – cittaṃ cittassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, (tīṇipi pūraitvā kātabbā, cittassāti kātabbā, sampayuttakānañ‍cāti kātabbā)|

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi|

puraijātapac‍cayau

345. ajjhattikau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ …pai॰… kāyaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kāyaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kāyaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā ca uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

346. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… taṃ ārabbha cittaṃ uppaj‍jati| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu cittassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa  ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – rūpai…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbai… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… taṃ ārabbha cittañ‍ca sampayuttakā khandhā ca uppaj‍janti| dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ  suṇāti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

347. ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| cakkhāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau  ca bāhirau ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| cakkhāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| cakkhāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca…pai॰… rūpāyatanañ‍ca  cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca…pai॰…| (3)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

348. ajjhattikau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – pacchājātā ajjhattikā khandhā puraijātassa imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) pacchājātā ajjhattikā khandhā puraijātassa imassa bāhirassa kāyassa pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) pacchājātā ajjhattikā khandhā puraijātassa imassa ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca kāyassa  pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (aivaṃ navapi pañhā kātabbā), āsaivanapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (nava pañhā kātabbā)|

kamma-vipākapac‍cayā

349. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – bāhirā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – bāhirā caitanā vipākānaṃ bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – bāhirā caitanā cittassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – bāhirā caitanā vipākassa cittassa ajjhattikānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – bāhirā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – bāhirā  caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3) vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… nava|

āhārapac‍cayau

350. ajjhattikau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā āhārā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ajjhattikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ  khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

351. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… bāhirau kabaḷīkārau āhārau bāhirassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā āhārā cittassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā āhārā cittassa ajjhattikānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau; bāhirau kabaḷīkārau āhārau ajjhattikassa kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; bāhirau kabaḷīkārau āhārau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca kāyassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

352. ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca āhārā  sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

indriyapac‍cayau

353. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā indriyā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cakkhundriyaṃ  cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ajjhattikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

354. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, rūpajīvitindriyaṃ bāhirānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā indriyā cittassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā indriyā cittassa ajjhattikānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, rūpajīvitindriyaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau  dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittassa ca ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca  kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, rūpajīvitindriyaṃ ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

355. ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca sukhindriyaṃ ca…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca dukkhindriyañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca  rūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca sukhindriyañ‍ca…pai॰… kāyindriyañ‍ca dukkhindriyañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau, cakkhundriyañ‍ca upaikkhindriyañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kāyindriyañ‍ca…pai॰…| (3)

jhānapac‍cayādi

356. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa jhānapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… maggapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… tīṇi… sampayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pañ‍ca|

vippayuttapac‍cayau

357. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ajjhattikā khandhā  puraijātassa imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – ajjhattikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ajjhattikā khandhā puraijātassa imassa bāhirassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā khandhā ajjhattikānañ‍ca bāhirānañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānañ‍ca khandhānaṃ…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ajjhattikā khandhā puraijātassa imassa ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

358. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – bāhirā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu bāhirānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – bāhirā khandhā puraijātassa imassa bāhirassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai bāhirā khandhā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu cittassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – bāhirā khandhā puraijātassa imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

359. ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātaṃ – pacchājātā…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā…pai॰… (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

atthipac‍cayādi

360. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇai cittaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… kāyaṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… (puraijātasadisaṃ, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)| pacchājātaṃ (pacchājātasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ)| (1)

ajjhattikau  dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātaṃ – sahajātā ajjhattikā khandhā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

(idha  atthi sabbaṭṭhānai sahajātaṃ pac‍cayavārasadisaṃ| puraijātaṃ puraijātasadisaṃ| pacchājātaṃ pacchājātasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ)|

ajjhattikau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

361. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (sabbaṃ vitthāraitabbaṃ)| (1)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (3)

362. ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā  ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyaviñ‍ñāṇasahagatā khandhā ca…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… kāyāyatanañ‍ca vatthu ca cittassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; rūpāyatanañ‍ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanañ‍ca kāyāyatanañ‍ca kāyaviñ‍ñāṇassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā puraijātassa  imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa ajjhattikassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – ajjhattikā ca bāhirā ca khandhā rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca ajjhattikānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau  – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… (sahajātapac‍cayavārasadisaṃ nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ, paṭhamagamanasadisaṃyaiva| sabbai padā paṭhamaghaṭanānayaina vibhajitabbā)| (2)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātau – cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇasahagatau aikau khandhau ca cakkhāyatanañ‍ca dvin‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (saṃkhittaṃ| sabbai padā vibhajitabbā paṭhamaghaṭanānayaina)| (3)

suddhaṃ

363. haituyā tīṇi, ārammaṇai nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantarai nava, samanantarai nava, sahajātai nava, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai pañ‍ca, nissayai nava, upanissayai nava, puraijātai nava, pacchājātai nava, āsaivanai nava, kammai tīṇi, vipākai nava, āhārai nava, indriyai nava, jhānai tīṇi, maggai tīṇi, sampayuttai pañ‍ca, vippayuttai nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigatai nava, avigatai nava|

pac‍canīyuddhārau

364. ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau  dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

365. bāhirau dhammau bāhirassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

bāhirau dhammau ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

366. ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau … sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

ajjhattikau ca bāhirau ca dhammā bāhirassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

ajjhattikau  ca bāhirau ca dhammā ajjhattikassa ca bāhirassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ
