7. pañhāvārau

1. pac‍cayānulaumaṃ

1. vibhaṅgavārau

haitupac‍cayau

63. upādānasampayuttau  dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – upādānasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – upādānasampayuttā haitū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā haitū diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ  khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

64. upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – upādānavippayuttā haitū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau  sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

65. upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau mauhau ca laubhau ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau mauhau ca laubhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānasampayuttau  ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau mauhau ca laubhau ca sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ haitupac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

ārammaṇapac‍cayau

66. upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – upādānasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha upādānasampayuttā  khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha upādānavippayuttā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttai khandhai ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

67. upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… upausathakammaṃ…pai॰… pubbai suciṇṇāni…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttau rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ uppaj‍jati, jhānai parihīnai vippaṭisārissa daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati| ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti, phalaṃ…pai॰… nibbānaṃ pac‍cavaikkhanti| nibbānaṃ gautrabhussa, vaudānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ariyā upādānavippayuttai pahīnai kilaisai…pai॰… vikkhambhitai kilaisai…pai॰… pubbai samudāciṇṇai kilaisai…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ upādānavippayuttai khandhai  ca laubhañ‍ca anic‍catau…pai॰… vipassati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttau rāgau…pai॰… vicikicchā…pai॰… uddhac‍caṃ…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati…pai॰… (sabbaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ), dibbaina cakkhunā… (yāva kāyaviñ‍ñāṇaṃ), upādānavippayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, caitaupariyañāṇassa, pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvaj‍janāya ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau – dānaṃ …pai॰… jhānaṃ…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ upādānavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ upādānavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

68. upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca ārabbha upādānasampayuttā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca ārabbha upādānavippayuttā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

adhipatipac‍cayau

69. upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – upādānasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā upādānasampayuttā khandhā uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – upādānasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – upādānasampayuttai  khandhai garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – upādānasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatādhipati laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – upādānasampayuttai khandhai garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| sahajātādhipati – upādānasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

70. upādānavippayuttau  dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… sīlaṃ…pai॰… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā pac‍cavaikkhati, assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati…pai॰… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pai॰… phalassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ upādānavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttau rāgau uppaj‍jati| sahajātādhipati – upādānavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau  upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ…pai॰… jhānaṃ…pai॰… cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ upādānavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| (2)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ upādānavippayuttai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

71. upādānasampayuttau  ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| ārammaṇādhipati – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā upādānasampayuttā khandhā uppaj‍janti| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau uppaj‍jati| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatai khandhai ca laubhañ‍ca garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| (3)

anantarapac‍cayau

72. upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā  purimā upādānasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā  khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; upādānasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

73. upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimau purimau diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; purimā purimā upādānavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādānavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; anulaumaṃ gautrabhussa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimau purimau diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| āvaj‍janā upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimau purimau diṭṭhigatavippayuttau laubhau pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; āvaj‍janā  diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

74. upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa  dhammassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa laubhassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca anantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

samanantarapac‍cayādi

75. upādānasampayuttau  dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ) nava… añ‍ñamañ‍ñapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… (paṭic‍casadisaṃ) cha… nissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… (pac‍cayavārasadisaṃ) nava|

upanissayapac‍cayau

76. upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – upādānasampayuttā khandhā upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā khandhā upādānavippayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) upādānasampayuttā  khandhā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

77. upādānavippayuttau  dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… samāpattiṃ uppādaiti, mānaṃ jappaiti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… upādānavippayuttaṃ rāgaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ daiti…pai॰… saṅghaṃ bhindati; saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ saddhāya…pai॰… pañ‍ñāya upādānavippayuttassa rāgassa… mānassa… patthanāya… kāyikassa sukhassa…pai॰… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – (tīṇi upanissayā) saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… upādānavippayuttaṃ rāgaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ… saināsanaṃ upanissāya adin‍naṃ…pai॰… musā…pai॰… pisuṇaṃ…pai॰… samphaṃ…pai॰… sandhiṃ…pai॰… nil‍laupaṃ…pai॰… aikāgārikaṃ…pai॰… paripanthai…pai॰… paradāraṃ…pai॰… gāmaghātaṃ…pai॰… nigamaghātaṃ karauti| saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upādānasampayuttassa rāgassa… mauhassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇūpanissayau, anantarūpanissayau, pakatūpanissayau…pai॰…| pakatūpanissayau – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappaiti, sīlaṃ…pai॰… pañ‍ñaṃ… upādānavippayuttaṃ  rāgaṃ…pai॰… saināsanaṃ upanissāya adin‍naṃ ādiyati…pai॰… gāmaghātaṃ karauti… nigamaghātaṃ karauti…| saddhā…pai॰… saināsanaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

78. upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca upādānavippayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (mūlaṃ kātabbaṃ) diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

puraijātapac‍cayau

79. upādānavippayuttau  dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ anic‍catau…pai॰… daumanassaṃ uppaj‍jati; dibbaina cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sautadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti| rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… phauṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pai॰…| vatthupuraijātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇassa…pai॰… kāyāyatanaṃ…pai॰… vatthu upādānavippayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ  – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ assādaiti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgau uppaj‍jati, diṭṭhi uppaj‍jati| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu upādānasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ, vatthupuraijātaṃ| ārammaṇapuraijātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pai॰… vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca uppaj‍janti| vatthupuraijātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

pacchājātāsaivanapac‍cayā

kamma-vipākapac‍cayā

81. upādānasampayuttau  dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – upādānasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – upādānasampayuttā caitanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ  rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā caitanā laubhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| nānākkhaṇikā – upādānasampayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānasampayuttau  dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – upādānasampayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

82. upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā| sahajātā – upādānavippayuttā caitanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau; paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰…| nānākkhaṇikā – upādānavippayuttā caitanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vipākapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – vipākau upādānavippayuttau aikau…pai॰… aikaṃ|

84. upādānasampayuttau  dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| puraijātaṃ – vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ| sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā…pai॰…|

upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

upādānasampayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau (paṭic‍casadisaṃ)| (3)

86. upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (1)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ)| (2)

upādānavippayuttau  dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ (imaisu sahajātaṃ sahajātasadisaṃ, puraijātaṃ puraijātasadisaṃ)| (3)

87. upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – upādānasampayuttau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau aikau khandhau ca laubhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (1)

upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ| sahajātā – upādānasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| sahajātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā  khandhā ca vatthu ca laubhassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca puraijātassa imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca kabaḷīkārau āhārau ca imassa kāyassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| pacchājātā – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatā khandhā ca laubhau ca rūpajīvitindriyañ‍ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau – sahajātaṃ, puraijātaṃ| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau aikau khandhau ca laubhau ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ‍ca rūpānaṃ atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| sahajātau – diṭṭhigatavippayuttalaubhasahagatau aikau khandhau ca vatthu ca tiṇṇan‍naṃ khandhānaṃ laubhassa ca atthipac‍cayaina pac‍cayau…pai॰… dvai khandhā ca…pai॰…| (3)

natthipac‍cayaina  pac‍cayau… vigatapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… avigatapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau|

suddhaṃ

88. haituyā nava, ārammaṇai nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantarai nava, samanantarai nava, sahajātai nava, añ‍ñamañ‍ñai cha, nissayai nava, upanissayai nava, puraijātai tīṇi, pacchājātai tīṇi, āsaivanai nava, kammai cattāri, vipākai aikaṃ, āhārai cattāri, indriyai cattāri, jhānai cattāri, maggai cattāri, sampayuttai cha, vippayuttai pañ‍ca, atthiyā nava, natthiyā nava, vigatai nava, avigatai nava|

90. upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau … pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… kammapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… āhārapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… indriyapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānavippayuttau  dhammau upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānavippayuttau dhammau upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa  ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… puraijātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

91. upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (1)

upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānavippayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… pacchājātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (2)

upādānasampayuttau ca upādānavippayuttau ca dhammā upādānasampayuttassa ca upādānavippayuttassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… sahajātapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau… upanissayapac‍cayaina pac‍cayau| (3)

2. pac‍cayapac‍canīyaṃ

2. saṅkhyāvārau

92. nahaituyā nava, naārammaṇai nava, naadhipatiyā nava (sabbattha nava), nauavigatai nava|

3. pac‍cayānulaumapac‍canīyaṃ

93. haitupac‍cayā  naārammaṇai nava, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantarai nava, nasamanantarai nava, naañ‍ñamañ‍ñai tīṇi, naupanissayai nava (sabbattha nava), nasampayuttai tīṇi, navippayuttai cha, naunatthiyā nava, nauvigatai nava|

(ghaṭanā  adhipati tīṇi, upādānadukasadisā| sabbai pac‍cayā upādānadukasadisā| upādāniyai laukuttaraṃ natthi, pac‍canīyampi itarai dvai gaṇanāpi upādānadukasadisaṃ|)

115. nahaitupac‍cayā  ārammaṇai nava, adhipatiyā nava…pai॰… (anulaumamātikā kātabbā)|

74. upādānavippayuttaupādāniyadukaṃ

1. paṭic‍cavārau

1-4. pac‍cayānulaumādi

haitupac‍cayau

116. upādānavippayuttaṃ  upādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca upādānavippayuttau upādāniyau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ upādāniyaṃ aikaṃ  khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰… paṭisandhikkhaṇai…pai॰… aikaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pai॰… mahābhūtai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ| (1)

upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca upādānavippayuttau anupādāniyau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (1)

upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca upādānavippayuttau upādāniyau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – upādānavippayuttai anupādāniyai khandhai paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (2)

upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca upādānavippayuttau upādāniyau ca upādānavippayuttau anupādāniyau ca dhammā uppaj‍janti haitupac‍cayā – upādānavippayuttaṃ  anupādāniyaṃ  aikaṃ khandhaṃ paṭic‍ca tayau khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ‍ca rūpaṃ…pai॰… dvai khandhai…pai॰…| (3)

upādānavippayuttaṃ upādāniyañ‍ca upādānavippayuttaṃ anupādāniyañ‍ca dhammaṃ paṭic‍ca upādānavippayuttau upādāniyau dhammau uppaj‍jati haitupac‍cayā – upādānavippayuttai anupādāniyai khandhai ca mahābhūtai ca paṭic‍ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ| (1)

haituyā pañ‍ca, ārammaṇai dvai…pai॰… avigatai pañ‍ca|

(imaṃ dukaṃ cūḷantaradukai laukiyadukasadisaṃ, nin‍nānākaraṇaṃ|)
